29/**
30 * 服务编排器
31 *
32 * 核心职责：
33 * 1. 加载所有 ServiceProvider（内置 + 模块扫描）
34 * 2. 按优先级启动/停止所有服务
35 * 3. 统一健康检查循环
36 * 4. 统一 IPC 消息处理
37 * 5. 所有进程操作委托给 Processer
38 */
39class ServiceOrchestrator
40{
41    private const STOP_STAGE_IDLE = 'idle';
42    private const STOP_STAGE_REQUESTED = 'requested';
43    private const STOP_STAGE_DRAIN = 'drain';
44    private const STOP_STAGE_WAIT_DRAIN = 'wait_drain';

326    private function cooperativeYieldIfNeeded(float &$lastYieldAt, float $sliceMs = 20.0): void
327    {
328        $now = \microtime(true);
329        if ((($now - $lastYieldAt) * 1000) < $sliceMs) {
330            return;
331        }
332        $lastYieldAt = $now;
333        SchedulerSystem::yield();
334    }

379    public function describeLifecycleState(): string
380    {
381        return 'running=' . ($this->running ? '1' : '0')
382            . ', shutting_down=' . ($this->shuttingDown ? '1' : '0')
383            . ', stop_all=' . ($this->stopAllInProgress ? '1' : '0')
384            . ', pending_stop=' . ($this->pendingStopReason ?? 'null')
385            . ', child_stop=' . ($this->childProcessStopInProgress ? '1' : '0')
386            . ', full_restart=' . ($this->fullRestartRequested ? '1' : '0')
387            . ', main_loop_tasks=' . \count($this->mainLoopTasks)
388            . ', startup_failure=' . ($this->startupFailureReason ?? 'null')
389            . ', control_server_close_reason=' . ($this->lastControlServerCloseReason ?? 'null');
390    }
391
392    private function isStopFlowActive(): bool
393    {
394        return $this->masterShutdownIntent
395            || $this->pendingStopReason !== null
396            || $this->stopAllInProgress
397            || $this->shuttingDown;
398    }
399
400    private function isRecoverySuspended(): bool
401    {
402        return $this->isStopFlowActive()
403            || $this->fullRestartRequested
404            || $this->childProcessStopInProgress;
405    }

407    private function setStopStage(string $stage): void
408    {
409        $this->stopStage = $stage;
410    }
411
412    private function sendStopAlreadyInProgress(?int $clientId = null): void
413    {
414        if ($clientId === null || $this->controlServer === null) {
415            return;
416        }
417
418        $this->controlServer->sendTo(
419            $clientId,
420            ControlMessage::commandResult(
421                true,
422                ['state' => 'stopping', 'stage' => $this->stopStage],
423                'Stop already in progress'
424            )
425        );
426    }
427
428    public function requestStop(string $reason = 'shutdown', ?int $progressClientId = null, bool $exclusiveIpc = false): bool
429    {
430        if ($this->stopAllInProgress || $this->shuttingDown || $this->pendingStopReason !== null) {
431            $this->sendStopAlreadyInProgress($progressClientId);
432            WlsLogger::warning_(
433                "[Orchestrator] 停机流程已在进行中，忽略重复 stop 请求，原因: {$reason}，阶段: {$this->stopStage}"
434            );
435            return false;
436        }
437
438        $this->masterShutdownIntent = true;
439        $this->fullRestartRequested = false;
440        $this->fullRestartReason = '';
441        $this->resurrectQueue = [];
442        $this->rollingRestartInProgress = false;
443        $this->rollingRestartClientId = null;
444        $this->rollingRestartProgress = 0;
445        $this->rollingRestartTotal = 0;
446
447        if ($exclusiveIpc && $progressClientId !== null) {
448            $this->ipcClearFieldForNewImperial($progressClientId, ControlMessage::ACTION_STOP);
449        } else {
450            $this->ipcImperialEpoch++;
451            $this->ipcExclusiveCommand = ControlMessage::ACTION_STOP;
452            $this->ipcExclusiveClientId = $progressClientId;
453            WlsLogger::warning_(
454                "[Orchestrator] 本地停机请求已接管控制面，原因: {$reason} imperial_epoch={$this->ipcImperialEpoch}"
455            );
456        }
457
458        $this->pendingStopReason = $reason;
459        $this->pendingStopProgressClientId = $progressClientId;
460        $this->setStopStage(self::STOP_STAGE_REQUESTED);
461
462        if ($progressClientId !== null && $this->controlServer !== null) {
463            $this->controlServer->sendTo(
464                $progressClientId,
465                ControlMessage::commandResult(
466                    true,
467                    ['state' => 'stopping', 'stage' => $this->stopStage],
468                    'Stopping'
469                )
470            );
471        }
472
473        WlsLogger::info_("[Orchestrator] 已接收停止请求，立即进入统一停机流程，原因: {$reason}");
474        return true;
475    }
476
477    private function handleStartupFailure(\Throwable $throwable, string $label): void
478    {
479        $this->startupFailureReason = $throwable->getMessage();
480        WlsLogger::error_("[Orchestrator] {$label}: " . $throwable->getMessage(), ['exception' => $throwable]);
481
482        if ($this->running || $this->controlServer !== null) {
483            $requested = $this->requestStop('startup_failure');
484            WlsLogger::warning_(
485                '[Orchestrator] startup failure handed over to unified stop flow'
486                . ', requested=' . ($requested ? '1' : '0')
487                . ', label=' . $label
488                . ', ' . $this->describeLifecycleState()
489            );
490            return;
491        }

496    private function consumePendingStopRequest(): bool
497    {
498        if ($this->pendingStopReason === null || $this->shuttingDown || $this->stopAllInProgress) {
499            return false;
500        }
501
502        $reason = $this->pendingStopReason;
503        $progressClientId = $this->pendingStopProgressClientId;
504        $this->pendingStopReason = null;
505        $this->pendingStopProgressClientId = null;
506        if ($this->hasMainLoopTask('control:stop_all')) {
507            return true;
508        }
509
510        if (!$this->scheduleMainLoopTask('control:stop_all', 'stop_all', function () use ($reason, $progressClientId): void {
511            try {
512                $this->stopAll($reason, $progressClientId);
513            } catch (\Throwable $throwable) {
514                WlsLogger::error_(
515                    '[Orchestrator] stopAll 执行异常，将重置停机状态并强制退出: ' . $throwable->getMessage(),
516                    ['exception' => $throwable]
517                );
518                $this->resetStopFlowFlagsAfterStopAllFailure();
519                $this->forceTerminateMasterAndChildren('stop_all_exception:' . $reason);
520            }
521        })) {
522            $this->pendingStopReason = $reason;
523            $this->pendingStopProgressClientId = $progressClientId;
524            return false;
525        }
526
527        return true;
528    }

818    private function scheduleMainLoopTask(string $key, string $label, callable $task): bool
819    {
820        if ($this->mainLoopFiberScheduler === null) {
821            $this->initializeMainLoopFiberScheduler();
822        }
823
824        if (isset($this->mainLoopTasks[$key])) {
825            return false;
826        }
827
828        $fiber = new \Fiber(function () use ($task): void {
829            SchedulerSystem::yield();
830            $task();
831        });
832
833        $this->mainLoopTasks[$key] = [
834            'fiber' => $fiber,
835            'label' => $label,
836            'startedAt' => \microtime(true),
837        ];
838        $this->mainLoopFiberScheduler->registerFiber();
839        $traceStartupTask = \str_starts_with($key, 'startup:');
840        if ($traceStartupTask) {
841            WlsLogger::info_("[Orchestrator] scheduling main-loop startup task {$label}");
842            WlsLogger::flush_(true);
843        }
844
845        try {
846            $fiber->start();
847            if ($traceStartupTask) {
848                WlsLogger::info_(
849                    "[Orchestrator] main-loop startup task {$label} started"
850                    . ', suspended=' . ($fiber->isSuspended() ? '1' : '0')
851                    . ', terminated=' . ($fiber->isTerminated() ? '1' : '0')
852                );
853                WlsLogger::flush_(true);
854            }
855        } catch (\Throwable $throwable) {
856            $this->mainLoopFiberScheduler->unregisterFiber();
857            unset($this->mainLoopTasks[$key]);
858            WlsLogger::error_("[Orchestrator] failed to start main-loop fiber task {$label}: {$throwable->getMessage()}");
859
860            return false;
861        }
862
863        if ($fiber->isTerminated()) {
864            $this->cleanupMainLoopTask($key);
865        }
866
867        return true;
868    }

870    private function tickMainLoopTasks(): void
871    {
872        if ($this->mainLoopFiberScheduler === null) {
873            return;
874        }
875
876        $budgetMs = (float) ($this->context?->getConfig('wls.orchestrator.fiber_tick_budget_ms', 50.0) ?? 50.0);
877        if ($budgetMs < 1.0) {

882        foreach (\array_keys($this->mainLoopTasks) as $key) {
883            if (!isset($this->mainLoopTasks[$key])) {
884                continue;
885            }
886
887            $fiber = $this->mainLoopTasks[$key]['fiber'];
888            if (!$fiber->isTerminated()) {
889                continue;
890            }
891
892            try {
893                $fiber->getReturn();
894            } catch (\Throwable $throwable) {
895                WlsLogger::error_(
896                    "[Orchestrator] main-loop fiber task crashed {$this->mainLoopTasks[$key]['label']}: {$throwable->getMessage()}"
897                );
898            }
899
900            $this->cleanupMainLoopTask($key);
901        }
902    }

940    private function processNextQueuedControlOperation(): bool
941    {

943            return false;
944        }

983    /**
984     * @param array{id:string,action:string,clientId:int,payload:array<string,mixed>,state:string,queuedAt:float,startedAt:?float} $operation
985     */
986    private function executeQueuedControlOperation(array $operation): void
987    {
988        $action = $operation['action'];
989        $clientId = $operation['clientId'];
990        $payload = $operation['payload'];
991        try {
992            switch ($action) {
993            case ControlMessage::ACTION_RELOAD:
994                $type = (string)($payload['reload_type'] ?? ControlMessage::RELOAD_TYPE_CODE);
995                if ($type === ControlMessage::RELOAD_TYPE_CACHE) {
996                    $this->broadcastCacheClear();
997                    return;
998                }
999                // 与 reload_wait 一致：占帝王位并固定 imperial 快照，避免异步重载进行中因发起端断连等原因 bump epoch 导致整段重载被误判「抢占中止」、子进程收不到 DRAIN/SHUTDOWN。
1000                $this->ipcClearFieldForNewImperial($clientId, ControlMessage::ACTION_RELOAD);
1001                $snap = $this->ipcImperialEpoch;
1002                try {
1003                    $this->reloadAll($type, $snap);
1004                } finally {
1005                    if ($this->ipcImperialEpoch === $snap && $this->ipcExclusiveClientId === $clientId) {
1006                        $this->ipcReleaseExclusive();
1007                    }
1008                }
1009                return;
1010
1011            case ControlMessage::ACTION_RELOAD_WAIT:
1012                $type = (string)($payload['reload_type'] ?? ControlMessage::RELOAD_TYPE_CODE);
1013                if ($type === ControlMessage::RELOAD_TYPE_CACHE) {

1167    /**
1168     * 加载内置 Provider
1169     */
1170    private function loadBuiltinProviders(): void
1171    {
1172        $builtinConfigPath = BP . 'app' . DS . 'code' . DS . 'Weline' . DS . 'Server' . DS . 'etc' . DS . 'wls_services.php';
1173        if (\is_file($builtinConfigPath)) {
1174            $this->loadModuleProviders($builtinConfigPath);
1175            return;
1176        }
1177
1178        $fallbackProviders = [
1179            Provider\SessionServerProvider::class,
1180            Provider\WorkerProvider::class,
1181            Provider\DispatcherProvider::class,
1182            Provider\HttpRedirectProvider::class,
1183            Provider\MaintenanceWorkerProvider::class,
1184            Provider\GatewayProvider::class,
1185        ];
1186        foreach ($fallbackProviders as $className) {
1187            if (!\class_exists($className)) {
1188                continue;
1189            }
1190            $provider = new $className();
1191            if (!$provider instanceof ServiceProviderInterface) {
1192                continue;
1193            }
1194            $this->registry->registerProvider($provider);
1195            WlsLogger::debug_("[Orchestrator] 注册内置 Provider(兜底): {$provider->getRole()} ({$provider->getDisplayName()})");

1197    }

1199    /**
1200     * 扫描模块的 etc/wls_services.php 文件
1201     */
1202    private function scanModuleProviders(): void
1203    {
1204        $modulesDir = BP . 'app' . DS . 'code';
1205        if (!\is_dir($modulesDir)) {
1206            return;
1207        }
1208
1209        $vendors = @\scandir($modulesDir);
1210        if ($vendors === false) {
1211            return;
1212        }
1213
1214        foreach ($vendors as $vendor) {
1215            if ($vendor === '.' || $vendor === '..') {
1216                continue;
1217            }
1218            $vendorPath = $modulesDir . DS . $vendor;
1219            if (!\is_dir($vendorPath)) {
1220                continue;
1221            }
1222
1223            $modules = @\scandir($vendorPath);
1224            if ($modules === false) {
1225                continue;
1226            }
1227
1228            foreach ($modules as $module) {
1229                if ($module === '.' || $module === '..') {
1230                    continue;
1231                }
1232                $servicePath = $vendorPath . DS . $module . DS . 'etc' . DS . 'wls_services.php';
1233                if (\is_file($servicePath)) {
1234                    $this->loadModuleProviders($servicePath);
1235                }
1236            }
1237        }
1238    }

1240    /**
1241     * 加载模块的 Provider 定义
1242     */
1243    private function loadModuleProviders(string $servicePath): void
1244    {
1245        try {
1246            $realPath = \realpath($servicePath) ?: $servicePath;
1247            if (isset($this->loadedProviderFiles[$realPath])) {
1248                return;
1249            }
1250            $this->loadedProviderFiles[$realPath] = true;
1251
1252            $providers = require $servicePath;
1253            if (!\is_array($providers)) {
1254                return;
1255            }
1256
1257            foreach ($providers as $className) {
1258                if (!\class_exists($className)) {
1259                    WlsLogger::warning_("[Orchestrator] Provider 类不存在: {$className} (from {$servicePath})");
1260                    continue;
1261                }
1262
1263                $provider = new $className();
1264                if (!$provider instanceof ServiceProviderInterface) {
1265                    WlsLogger::warning_("[Orchestrator] {$className} 未实现 ServiceProviderInterface (from {$servicePath})");
1266                    continue;
1267                }
1268
1269                if ($this->registry->hasProvider($provider->getRole())) {
1270                    WlsLogger::warning_("[Orchestrator] 角色 {$provider->getRole()} 已注册，跳过: {$className}");
1271                    continue;
1272                }
1273
1274                $this->registry->registerProvider($provider);
1275                WlsLogger::info_("[Orchestrator] 注册模块 Provider: {$provider->getRole()} ({$provider->getDisplayName()}) from {$servicePath}");
1276            }
1277        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
1278            WlsLogger::error_("[Orchestrator] 加载 {$servicePath} 失败: {$e->getMessage()}");
1279        }
1280    }

1421     * 2) 启用维护 Provider 并设置实例数（由第一阶段批量并发拉起）
1422     *
1423     * 不在此处等待维护 Worker READY，避免串行阻塞主启动链路。
1424     */
1425    private function autoStartMaintenanceMode(ServiceContext $context): void
1426    {
1427        $maintenanceProvider = $this->getMaintenanceProvider();
1428        if ($maintenanceProvider === null) {
1429            return;
1430        }
1431
1432        $workerCount = $context->getWorkerCount();
1433        if ($workerCount === 'auto') {
1434            $workerProvider = $this->registry->getProvider(ControlMessage::ROLE_WORKER);
1435            $workerCount = $workerProvider?->getInstanceCount($context) ?? 1;
1436        }
1437        $workerCount = \max(1, (int) $workerCount);
1438        $nMaint = \max(1, (int)\ceil($workerCount / 3));
1439        $sticky = (bool) (
1440            ($context->envConfig['system']['maintenance'] ?? null)
1441            ?? ($context->envConfig['maintenance'] ?? false)
1442        );
1443
1444        $maintenanceProvider->enable($nMaint);
1445        $this->maintenanceMode = true;
1446        $this->maintenanceSticky = $sticky;
1447        $this->desiredState[ControlMessage::ROLE_MAINTENANCE] = $nMaint;
1448        // 供 sticky 维护与就绪判断使用，避免 desiredState 未写入 worker 时误用默认 desired=1
1449        $this->desiredState[ControlMessage::ROLE_WORKER] = $workerCount;
1450        $this->logMaintenanceOperation(
1451            '自动维护模式预置完成，待第一阶段并发拉起 maintenance workers='
1452            . $nMaint
1453            . ', sticky='
1454            . ($sticky ? 'true' : 'false')
1455            . '，'
1456            . $this->formatMaintenanceOperationContext(),
1457            'INFO',
1458            'auto_start_maintenance:' . $nMaint . ':' . ($sticky ? '1' : '0') . ':' . $this->formatMaintenanceOperationContext(),
1459            0.0
1460        );
1461    }
1462
1463    /**
1464     * 检查业务 Worker 是否已就绪，决定是否退出维护模式
1465     *
1466     * @return bool true = 业务 Worker 已就绪，可以退出维护模式
1467     */
1468    public function checkAndDisableMaintenanceIfReady(): bool
1469    {
1470        if (!$this->maintenanceMode) {
1471            return true;
1472        }
1473
1474        if ($this->maintenanceSticky) {
1475            // 显式 sticky 维护模式只允许人工关闭，业务 Worker READY 仅用于待命，不自动切回业务池。
1476            return false;
1477        }
1478
1479        $workers = $this->registry->getInstancesByRole('worker');
1480        $readyCount = 0;
1481        foreach ($workers as $w) {
1482            if ($w->state === Contract\ServiceInstance::STATE_READY && $w->port !== null && $w->port > 0) {
1483                $readyCount++;
1484            }
1485        }
1486
1487        $desired = (int)($this->desiredState[ControlMessage::ROLE_WORKER] ?? 0);
1488        if ($desired <= 0) {
1489            $desired = 1;
1490        }
1491
1492        // 业务 Worker 就绪比例达标
1493        if ($readyCount >= $desired) {
1494            $result = $this->disableMaintenanceMode();
1495            WlsLogger::info_('[Orchestrator] 业务 Worker 已就绪(' . $readyCount . '/' . $desired . ')，退出维护模式: ' . ($result['message'] ?? ''));
1496            return true;
1497        }
1498
1499        return false;
1500    }
1501
1502    public function startAll(ServiceContext $context): void
1503    {
1504        $this->bootstrapControlPlane($context);
1505        $this->cleanupStartupInterferenceProcesses($context);
1506        $this->startAllChildServices($context);
1507    }
1508
1509    /**
1510     * 启动前清理当前实例的遗留子进程，避免旧代际 register/ready 干扰新一轮启动。
1511     * 仅按“实例作用域前缀”清理，不影响其它实例。
1512     */
1513    private function cleanupStartupInterferenceProcesses(ServiceContext $context): void
1514    {
1515        $enabled = (bool) ($context->getConfig('wls.orchestrator.startup_cleanup_interference_processes', true) ?? true);
1516        if (!$enabled) {
1517            return;
1518        }
1519
1520        $instanceName = (string) ($context->instanceName ?: 'default');
1521        $prefixes = [
1522            MasterProcess::buildScopedProcessName('weline-wls-worker', $instanceName),
1523            MasterProcess::buildScopedProcessName('weline-wls-maintenance', $instanceName),
1524            MasterProcess::buildScopedProcessName('weline-wls-dispatcher', $instanceName),
1525            MasterProcess::buildScopedProcessName('weline-wls-redirect', $instanceName),
1526            // 兼容历史命名（无 project scope / 旧 master 前缀），避免旧进程跨代际重连干扰启动。
1527            'weline-wls-worker-' . $instanceName,
1528            'weline-wls-maintenance-' . $instanceName,
1529            'weline-wls-dispatcher-' . $instanceName,
1530            'weline-wls-redirect-' . $instanceName,
1531            'weline-master-' . $instanceName . '-worker-',
1532            'weline-master-' . $instanceName . '-maintenance-',
1533            'weline-master-' . $instanceName . '-dispatcher-',
1534            'weline-master-' . $instanceName . '-redirect-',
1535        ];
1536        $prefixes = \array_values(\array_unique($prefixes));
1537
1538        $killed = 0;
1539        foreach ($prefixes as $prefix) {
1540            $killed += Processer::killByProcessNamePrefix($prefix);
1541        }
1542        $staleRemoved = Processer::cleanupStalePidFiles();
1543
1544        if ($killed > 0 || $staleRemoved > 0) {
1545            WlsLogger::warning_(
1546                "[Orchestrator] 启动前清场完成: instance={$instanceName}, killed={$killed}, stale_pid_files={$staleRemoved}"
1547            );
1548        } else {
1549            WlsLogger::debug_("[Orchestrator] 启动前清场：未发现当前实例遗留子进程 instance={$instanceName}");
1550        }
1551    }
1552
1553    /**
1554     * bootstrapControlPlane 之后拉起子进程与启动验收（供同步 startAll 与 runLoop 内 Fiber 延迟启动共用）。
1555     */
1556    private function startAllChildServices(ServiceContext $context): void
1557    {
1558        $this->childServicesBootstrapInProgress = true;
1559        try {
1560            $this->startAllChildServicesBody($context);
1561        } finally {
1562            $this->childServicesBootstrapInProgress = false;
1563        }
1564    }
1565
1566    /**
1567     * @see startAllChildServices
1568     */
1569    private function startAllChildServicesBody(ServiceContext $context): void
1570    {
1571        // 计算子服务启动截止绝对时间（用于计算总启动时间）
1572        $this->childServicesStartupDeadline = \microtime(true) + $this->startupMaxDuration;
1573        WlsLogger::info_('[Orchestrator] 子服务启动开始，截止时间: '
1574            . \date('H:i:s', (int)$this->childServicesStartupDeadline)
1575            . ' (总超时限制: ' . $this->startupMaxDuration . 's)');
1576
1577        // 所有服务统一并发启动（包括 session/memory 共享服务）
1578        $providers = $this->sortProvidersForStartup($this->registry->getAllProviders());
1579        $startedCount = 0;
1580        $startupAcceptance = [];
1581
1582        $phaseOneProviders = [];  // 非 Worker（与 Worker 合并后仍由 sortProvidersForStartup 的优先级排序）
1583        $workerProviders = [];
1584
1585        foreach ($providers as $provider) {
1586            if (!$provider->isEnabled($context)) {
1587                WlsLogger::debug_("[Orchestrator] 服务 {$provider->getRole()} 未启用，跳过");
1588                continue;
1589            }
1590            $role = $provider->getRole();
1591            // 移除共享服务特殊处理，让它们像普通服务一样参与并发启动
1592            $this->desiredState[$role] = $provider->getInstanceCount($context);
1593            if ($role === ControlMessage::ROLE_WORKER) {
1594                $workerProviders[] = $provider;
1595            } else {
1596                $phaseOneProviders[] = $provider;
1597            }
1598        }
1599
1600        $criticalRoles = $this->getWorkerCriticalInfraRoles();
1601
1602        WlsLogger::info_('[Orchestrator] 所有本地子服务一并并发启动（包括共享服务）');
1603        if ($context->frontend) {
1604            echo "\033[34m  开始启动所有进程（并发）...\033[0m\n";
1605        }
1606
1607        $allProviders = \array_values(\array_filter(
1608            \array_merge($phaseOneProviders, $workerProviders),
1609            fn (ServiceProviderInterface $p): bool => $p->getInstanceCount($context) > 0
1610        ));
1611        $allInstances = $this->startProvidersBatch($allProviders, $context);
1612
1613        foreach ($allProviders as $provider) {
1614            $role = $provider->getRole();
1615            $instanceCount = $provider->getInstanceCount($context);
1616            $displayName = $provider->getDisplayName();
1617
1618            foreach (($allInstances[$role] ?? []) as $instance) {
1619                if ($instance !== null) {
1620                    $startedCount++;
1621                    if ($context->frontend) {
1622                        $portInfo = $instance->port !== null ? " (port={$instance->port})" : '';
1623                        echo "\033[32m      ✓ {$displayName}#{$instance->instanceId}{$portInfo}\033[0m\n";
1624                    }
1625                }
1626            }
1627
1628            if ($provider->requiresStartupReadyBarrier()) {
1629                $minReady = $this->resolveStartupAcceptanceMinReady($role, $instanceCount, $context);
1630                $startupAcceptance[$role] = [
1631                    'displayName' => $displayName,
1632                    'expected' => $instanceCount,
1633                    'minReady' => $minReady,
1634                ];
1635            }
1636        }
1637
1638        // Startup children often connect a few seconds apart on Windows.
1639        // Keep draining for a full window instead of only polling one frame,
1640        // otherwise later READY/ACK messages get stranded behind the next
1641        // batch spawn.
1642        $drainStartedAt = \microtime(true);
1643        $this->drainControlPlaneAfterStartupStep(360, 50000, 4, 12000000);
1644        WlsLogger::info_(
1645            '[Orchestrator][StartupTiming] concurrent startup drain elapsed='
1646            . \max(0, (int) \round((\microtime(true) - $drainStartedAt) * 1000))
1647            . 'ms'
1648        );
1649        if ($this->shouldAbortStartupTransition()) {
1650            return;
1651        }
1652
1653        if ($context->frontend) {
1654            echo "\033[32m  共启动 {$startedCount} 个服务实例\033[0m\n";
1655        }
1656
1657        // 统一的启动验收阶段
1658        if (!empty($startupAcceptance)) {
1659            $this->waitForStartupAcceptance($startupAcceptance, $context);
1660            if ($this->shouldAbortStartupTransition()) {
1661                return;
1662            }
1663        }
1664
1665        WlsLogger::info_('[Orchestrator] 所有服务启动完成');
1666
1667        // 记录启动完成时间（用于启动后冷却期）
1668        $this->startAllCompletedAt = \microtime(true);
1669
1670        // 启动后置任务改为异步调度，避免在启动 Fiber 内同步阻塞。
1671        $this->schedulePostStartupHousekeeping($context);
1672    }
1673
1674    /**
1675     * 控制面已就绪后进入主循环，并在 Fiber 中执行子服务启动，使等待窗口内仍能 poll IPC（方案 B：启动完成后再回调，例如释放启动锁）。
1676     *
1677     * @param \Closure():void|null $afterChildStartup 子服务启动流程结束（成功/早退/异常 finally）后调用
1678     */
1679    public function runLoopWithDeferredChildStartup(ServiceContext $context, ?\Closure $afterChildStartup = null): void
1680    {
1681        $this->context ??= $context;
1682        if (!$this->scheduleMainLoopTask('startup:child_services', 'child_service_startup', function () use ($context, $afterChildStartup): void {
1683            try {
1684                $this->startAllChildServices($context);
1685            } catch (\Throwable $e) {
1686                $this->handleStartupFailure($e, '延迟启动子服务异常');
1687                throw $e;
1688            } finally {
1689                if ($afterChildStartup !== null) {
1690                    ($afterChildStartup)();
1691                }
1692            }
1693        })) {
1694            try {
1695                $this->startAllChildServices($context);
1696            } catch (\Throwable $e) {
1697                $this->handleStartupFailure($e, '子服务启动异常');
1698                throw $e;
1699            } finally {
1700                if ($afterChildStartup !== null) {
1701                    ($afterChildStartup)();
1702                }
1703            }
1704        }
1705
1706        $this->runLoop();
1707    }
1708
1709    /**
1710     * 启动完成后的后置任务（异步）：
1711     * - 持久化实例信息
1712     * - 广播路由策略
1713     * - 触发 ready 通知
1714     *
1715     * 设计目标：避免在启动主路径内做同步 IO/广播，缩短 READY/ACK 窗口延迟。
1716     */
1717    private function schedulePostStartupHousekeeping(ServiceContext $context): void
1718    {
1719        if ($this->scheduleMainLoopTask('startup:post_housekeeping', 'post_startup_housekeeping', function () use ($context): void {
1720            $this->persistServicesInfo($context);
1721            $this->broadcastRoutingPolicyToWorkers();
1722            $this->armServerReadyNotification();
1723        })) {
1724            return;
1725        }
1726
1727        // 兜底：调度失败时仍执行，保证功能正确性。
1728        $this->persistServicesInfo($context);
1729        $this->broadcastRoutingPolicyToWorkers();
1730        $this->armServerReadyNotification();
1731    }
1732
1733    /**
1734     * 启动前 Provider 排序：本地子服务一律在同一次 startProvidersBatch 中并发拉起，
1735     * 此处仅按 priority 与 role 名稳定排序（不再按 Dispatcher/Worker 分阶段）。
1736     *
1737     * @param ServiceProviderInterface[] $providers
1738     * @return ServiceProviderInterface[]
1739     */
1740    private function sortProvidersForStartup(array $providers): array
1741    {
1742        \usort($providers, static function (ServiceProviderInterface $a, ServiceProviderInterface $b): int {
1743            $pa = $a->getPriority();
1744            $pb = $b->getPriority();
1745            if ($pa !== $pb) {
1746                return $pa <=> $pb;
1747            }
1748
1749            return \strcmp($a->getRole(), $b->getRole());
1750        });
1751
1752        return $providers;
1753    }
1754
1755    private function resolveStartupAcceptanceMinReady(string $role, int $expected, ServiceContext $context): int
1756    {
1757        $ratio = (float)($context->getConfig('wls.orchestrator.startup_acceptance_ratio', 1.0) ?? 1.0);
1758        $min = (int)($context->getConfig('wls.orchestrator.startup_acceptance_min_ready', 1) ?? 1);
1759        $roleMap = $context->getConfig('wls.orchestrator.startup_acceptance_min_ready_by_role', []);
1760        if (\is_array($roleMap) && isset($roleMap[$role])) {
1761            $min = (int)$roleMap[$role];
1762        } elseif ($role === ControlMessage::ROLE_WORKER) {
1763            // Worker 启动默认策略：谁先 READY 先接流量，不要求全量就绪。
1764            $ratio = (float)($context->getConfig('wls.orchestrator.worker_startup_acceptance_ratio', 0.0) ?? 0.0);
1765            $min = (int)($context->getConfig('wls.orchestrator.worker_startup_acceptance_min_ready', 1) ?? 1);
1766        }
1767
1768        if ($ratio <= 0.0) {
1769            $ratio = 0.0;
1770        }
1771        if ($ratio > 1.0) {
1772            $ratio = 1.0;
1773        }
1774
1775        $ratioMin = (int)\ceil($expected * $ratio);
1776        $resolved = \max(1, $min, $ratioMin);
1777        if ($resolved > $expected) {
1778            $resolved = $expected;
1779        }
1780
1781        return $resolved;
1782    }
1783
1784    /**
1785     * 统一启动验收：按角色等待 READY 数达到阈值，避免逐实例串行等待导致启动过慢。
1786     *
1787     * @param array<string,array{displayName:string,expected:int,minReady:int}> $startupAcceptance
1788     */
1789    protected function waitForStartupAcceptance(array $startupAcceptance, ServiceContext $context): void
1790    {
1791        if ($this->controlServer === null) {
1792            return;
1793        }
1794
1795        $deadline = \microtime(true) + $this->startupTimeout;
1796        $lastPending = '';
1797        $lastProgressLogAt = 0.0;
1798        $acceptanceStartAt = \microtime(true);
1799        $this->lastStartupAcceptanceInfraProbeAt = 0.0;
1800        while (\microtime(true) < $deadline) {
1801            // Do a short multi-step drain first instead of a single poll(0,0).
1802            // This reduces the chance that register/ready packets which arrive
1803            // a few milliseconds apart stay queued until the next startup phase.
1804            $this->drainControlPlaneAfterStartupStep(6, 25000, 2, 50000);
1805
1806            // 关键：在 Fiber 内主动处理控制操作，避免被主循环阻塞
1807            // 这确保 maintenance_enable 等操作能及时执行
1808            if ($this->pendingControlOperations !== []) {
1809                $this->processNextQueuedControlOperation();
1810            }
1811
1812            if ($this->shouldAbortStartupTransition()) {
1813                return;
1814            }
1815            $this->maybeRecoverCriticalStartupInfraDuringAcceptance();
1816            $pending = [];
1817            foreach ($startupAcceptance as $role => $rule) {
1818                // 跳过 maintenance 的就绪检查 - maintenance 仅用于 reload 时接管，不应阻塞启动
1819                if ($role === 'maintenance') {
1820                    continue;
1821                }
1822                $readyCount = $this->countRoleReadyInstances((string)$role);
1823                if ($readyCount < $rule['minReady']) {
1824                    $pending[] = "{$role}:{$readyCount}/{$rule['minReady']}";
1825                }
1826            }
1827
1828            if ($pending === []) {
1829                $this->triggerStartupInfraRecoveryAfterWorkerReady();
1830                WlsLogger::info_('[Orchestrator] 启动验收通过: 所有关键角色 READY 已达阈值（跳过 maintenance 检查）');
1831                $this->startupAcceptanceComplete = true;
1832                return;
1833            }
1834
1835            $pendingLabel = \implode(', ', $pending);
1836            if ($pendingLabel !== $lastPending) {
1837                WlsLogger::info_("[Orchestrator] 启动验收中: {$pendingLabel}（maintenance 检查已跳过）");
1838                $lastPending = $pendingLabel;
1839                $lastProgressLogAt = \microtime(true);
1840            } elseif ((\microtime(true) - $lastProgressLogAt) >= 5.0) {

1871                );

1874                }
1875            }
1876        }
1877    }

2590    /**
2591     * @param array<string, mixed> $inspection
2592     * @return list<string>
2593     */
2594    private function collectSharedSidecarProbeTokens(string $role, int $port, string $expectedTokenFileName, array $inspection): array
2595    {
2596        $seen = [];
2597        $out = [];

2599            $t = \trim($t);
2600            if ($t === '' || isset($seen[$t])) {
2601                return;
2602            }
2603            $seen[$t] = true;
2604            $out[] = $t;
2605        };

2607        $push($expectedTokenFileName);

2618            $push('memory_server.token');

2621        }

2623        if (\defined('BP')) {

2626                foreach (\glob($dir . '*.token') ?: [] as $path) {
2627                    $push(\basename((string) $path));
2628                    if (\count($out) >= 28) {
2629                        break;
2630                    }
2631                }
2632            }
2633        }
2634
2635        return $out;

2638    protected function probeSharedSidecarEndpoint(string $host, int $port, string $tokenFileName): bool

2697    private function preserveExternallyManagedSharedInstance(ServiceInstance $instance, string $reason): bool

2712        if (($this->infraDegraded[$instance->role] ?? false) === true) {

2717        WlsLogger::info_(

2719        );
2720
2721        if ($this->context !== null) {
2722            $this->persistServicesInfo($this->context);

2728    /**
2729     * 持久化服务实例信息到实例文件
2730     *
2731     * 委托给 ServerInstanceManager 统一管理，确保所有命令获取到一致的实例信息。
2732     */
2733    private function persistServicesInfo(ServiceContext $context): void
2734    {
2735        $this->persistServicesInfoDirty = true;
2736        $this->persistServicesInfoContext = $context;
2737
2738        $now = \microtime(true);
2739        $delta = $now - $this->lastPersistServicesInfoAt;
2740        if ($delta < $this->persistServicesInfoMinIntervalSec) {
2741            if (!$this->hasMainLoopTask('mainloop:persist_services_info')) {
2742                $this->scheduleMainLoopTask('mainloop:persist_services_info', 'persist_services_info', function (): void {
2743                    $waitMs = (int)\max(1, \ceil($this->persistServicesInfoMinIntervalSec * 1000));
2744                    SchedulerSystem::yieldDelay($waitMs);
2745                    $this->flushPersistServicesInfo();
2746                });
2747            }
2748            return;
2749        }
2750
2751        $this->flushPersistServicesInfo();
2752    }

2754    /**
2755     * 真正执行实例信息落盘（带节流入口 persistServicesInfo 调用）。
2756     */
2757    private function flushPersistServicesInfo(): void

2760            return;
2761        }
2762        $context = $this->persistServicesInfoContext;
2763        $manager = new ServerInstanceManager();
2764        if (!$manager->hasInstance($context->instanceName)) {
2765            $this->persistServicesInfoDirty = false;

2767        }
2768        
2769        // 收集所有服务实例并转换为 ServiceInfo
2770        $services = [];
2771        $allInstances = $this->registry->getAllInstances();

3109    /**

3111     * @return array{

3209        $this->markSpawnedInstance(
3210            $instance,
3211            $spawnStartedAt,

3213            $pid,
3214            (string) $instance->getMeta('spawn_transport', 'spawn_process')

3226    /**
3227     * 委托给 Processer 启动进程
3228     *
3229     * 注意：Windows 下使用 block=false，PID 可能不准确（返回 cmd.exe PID）
3230     * 健康检查通过 IPC 连接状态判断，不依赖 PID
3231     */
3232    private function spawnProcess(ServiceCommand $command, ServiceInstance $instance): int
3233    {
3234        $cmd = $command->build();
3235        if ($instance->epoch > 0) {
3236            $cmd .= ' --epoch=' . \escapeshellarg((string)$instance->epoch);
3237        }
3238        if ($instance->launchId !== '') {
3239            $cmd .= ' --launch-id=' . \escapeshellarg($instance->launchId);
3240        }
3241        $processName = $command->getProcessName();
3242
3243        if ($processName !== null) {
3244            $cmd .= ' --name=' . \escapeshellarg($processName);
3245        }
3246
3247        WlsLogger::debug_("[Orchestrator] 执行命令: {$cmd}");
3248
3249        $foreground = $this->shouldLaunchForeground($instance->role, $this->context);
3250        $argv = $this->buildWindowsDetachedPhpArgvForCommand($command, $instance, $processName);
3251        if ($argv !== []) {
3252            $instance->setMeta('spawn_transport', 'windows_detached_php_argv');
3253            return Processer::createWindowsDetachedPhpArgv(
3254                $argv,
3255                $command->getWorkingDir(),
3256                $cmd
3257            );
3258        }
3259
3260        // 必须 block=false，否则会阻塞 Master 主循环。
3261        // Windows 前台模式下允许 Worker 打开独立控制台窗口，便于直接观察每个槽位的启动与请求日志。
3262        $instance->setMeta('spawn_transport', $foreground ? 'processer_create_foreground' : 'processer_create');
3263        return Processer::create(
3264            $cmd,
3265            block: false,
3266            foreground: $foreground
3267        );
3268    }
3269
3270    /**
3271     * Windows 后台启动优先走 argv 版 Start-Process：
3272     * - 避免整段命令行经 shell / PowerShell 再解析带来的慢启动与编码问题
3273     * - 更快返回 PID，减少 startup Fiber 长时间卡在 spawnProcess 阶段
3274     *
3275     * @return list<string>
3276     */
3277    private function buildWindowsDetachedPhpArgvForCommand(
3278        ServiceCommand $command,
3279        ServiceInstance $instance,
3280        ?string $processName
3281    ): array {
3282        if (!(\defined('IS_WIN') && IS_WIN)) {
3283            return [];
3284        }
3285        if ($this->shouldLaunchForeground($instance->role, $this->context)) {
3286            return [];
3287        }
3288        if ($command->environment !== []) {
3289            return [];
3290        }
3291
3292        $argv = [
3293            PHP_BINARY,
3294            $command->getAbsoluteScript(),
3295            ...\array_map(static fn (mixed $arg): string => (string) $arg, $command->arguments),
3296        ];
3297
3298        if ($instance->epoch > 0) {
3299            $argv[] = '--epoch=' . (string) $instance->epoch;
3300        }
3301        if ($instance->launchId !== '') {
3302            $argv[] = '--launch-id=' . $instance->launchId;
3303        }
3304        if ($processName !== null && $processName !== '') {
3305            $argv[] = '--name=' . $processName;
3306        }
3307
3308        return $argv;
3309    }

3311    private function shouldLaunchForeground(string $role, ?ServiceContext $context): bool
3312    {
3313        if ($context === null || !$context->frontend) {
3314            return false;
3315        }
3316
3317        if (\defined('IS_WIN') && IS_WIN) {
3318            // Windows 下前台子进程拉起成本很高，默认强制走后台 detached。
3319            // 仅当显式允许时，才读取 legacy 的前台子进程配置。
3320            $allowWindowsFrontendChildProcess = (bool) ($context->getConfig(
3321                'wls.orchestrator.allow_windows_frontend_child_process',
3322                false
3323            ) ?? false);
3324            if (!$allowWindowsFrontendChildProcess) {
3325                return false;
3326            }
3327
3328            if (\in_array($role, [ControlMessage::ROLE_WORKER, ControlMessage::ROLE_MAINTENANCE], true)) {
3329                return (bool) ($context->getConfig('wls.orchestrator.frontend_worker_windows', false) ?? false);
3330            }
3331
3332            return (bool) ($context->getConfig('wls.orchestrator.frontend_non_worker_windows', false) ?? false);
3333        }
3334
3335        if (\in_array($role, [ControlMessage::ROLE_WORKER, ControlMessage::ROLE_MAINTENANCE], true)) {
3336            return false;
3337        }
3338
3339        return true;
3340    }

3342    /**
3343     * 生成启动实例唯一 launchId
3344     */
3345    private function generateLaunchId(string $role, int $instanceId): string
3346    {
3347        try {
3348            $rand = \bin2hex(\random_bytes(6));
3349        } catch (\Throwable) {
3350            $rand = (string)\mt_rand(100000, 999999);
3351        }
3352        return "{$role}-{$instanceId}-{$rand}";
3353    }

3355    /**
3356     * 停止所有服务（优雅停止：广播-等待-关闭模式）
3357     *
3358     * 流程：
3359     * 1. 广播 DRAIN 给所有实例
3360     * 2. 等待所有实例排水完成（持续 poll IPC）
3361     * 3. 广播 SHUTDOWN 给所有实例
3362     * 4. 等待子服务 IPC 断开（不含 control/CLI；可配 stop_all_ipc_disconnect_wait_sec）
3363     * 5. 强制杀死残留进程
3364     * 6. 冲刷出站缓冲后关闭 IPC 服务器（stop_ipc_flush_before_close_sec）
3365     * @param string $reason 停止原因
3366     * @param int|null $progressClientId 发送进度消息的客户端 ID（用于 CLI stop 命令）
3367     */
3368    public function stopAll(string $reason = 'shutdown', ?int $progressClientId = null): void
3369    {
3370        if ($this->stopAllInProgress || $this->shuttingDown) {
3371            $this->sendStopAlreadyInProgress($progressClientId);
3372            WlsLogger::warning_("[Orchestrator] 已在停机流程中，忽略重复 stopAll 请求，原因: {$reason}，阶段: {$this->stopStage}");
3373            return;
3374        }
3375
3376        $this->pendingStopReason = null;
3377        $this->pendingStopProgressClientId = null;
3378        $this->stopAllInProgress = true;
3379        $this->shuttingDown = true;
3380        $this->masterShutdownIntent = true;
3381        $this->stopProgressClientId = $progressClientId;
3382        WlsLogger::info_("[Orchestrator] 开始停止所有服务，原因: {$reason}");
3383
3384        $totalInstances = \count($this->registry->getAllInstances());
3385        if ($totalInstances === 0) {
3386            WlsLogger::info_('[Orchestrator] 无运行中的实例');
3387            $this->sendStopProgress('无运行中的实例');
3388            $this->setStopStage(self::STOP_STAGE_COMPLETE);
3389            $this->running = false;
3390            $this->closeIpcServer('stop_all:no_running_instances');
3391            $this->finalizeStopAllMasterExit();
3392            return;
3393        }
3394
3395        // 构建实例清单
3396        $instanceList = [];
3397        foreach ($this->registry->getAllInstances() as $inst) {
3398            $provider = $this->registry->getProvider($inst->role);
3399            $displayName = $provider?->getDisplayName() ?? $inst->role;
3400            $instanceList[] = "{$displayName}(PID:{$inst->pid})";
3401        }
3402        $this->sendStopProgress("共 {$totalInstances} 个实例待停止: " . \implode(', ', $instanceList));
3403
3404        // ========== 阶段 1：广播 DRAIN ==========
3405        $this->setStopStage(self::STOP_STAGE_DRAIN);
3406        WlsLogger::info_('[Orchestrator] 阶段1: 广播 DRAIN');
3407        $this->sendStopProgress('阶段1/6: 广播 DRAIN - 通知子进程停止接受新请求');
3408        $this->broadcastDrainToAll();
3409
3410        // ========== 阶段 2：等待排水完成（默认 10s，可配 wls.orchestrator.stop_all_drain_wait_sec）==========
3411        $this->setStopStage(self::STOP_STAGE_WAIT_DRAIN);
3412        WlsLogger::info_('[Orchestrator] 阶段2: 等待排水完成');
3413        $this->sendStopProgress('阶段2/6: 等待排水完成 - 子进程处理完当前请求');
3414        $stopDrainWait = (float) ($this->context?->getConfig('wls.orchestrator.stop_all_drain_wait_sec', 10.0) ?? 10.0);
3415        if ($stopDrainWait < 1.0) {
3416            $stopDrainWait = 1.0;
3417        }
3418        if ($stopDrainWait > 300.0) {
3419            $stopDrainWait = 300.0;
3420        }
3421        $this->waitForAllDrained($stopDrainWait, true);
3422
3423        // ========== 阶段 3：统一终止子进程（并发） ==========
3424        $this->setStopStage(self::STOP_STAGE_SHUTDOWN);
3425        WlsLogger::info_('[Orchestrator] 阶段3: 统一终止子进程');
3426        $this->sendStopProgress('阶段3/6: 统一终止子进程 - 排水后并行结束所有服务');
3427        $this->broadcastShutdownToAll();
3428        $this->terminateAllAfterDrain();
3429
3430        // ========== 阶段 4：等待子服务 IPC 断开（排除 control/CLI；可配超时）==========
3431        $this->setStopStage(self::STOP_STAGE_WAIT_EXIT);
3432        WlsLogger::info_('[Orchestrator] 阶段4: 等待子进程断开 IPC');
3433        $this->sendStopProgress('阶段4/6: 等待子进程断开 IPC（可配 wls.orchestrator.stop_all_ipc_disconnect_wait_sec）');
3434        $this->waitForServiceIpcDisconnectAfterShutdown();
3435
3436        // ========== 阶段 5：校验并强制杀死残留进程 ==========
3437        $this->setStopStage(self::STOP_STAGE_VERIFY);
3438        WlsLogger::info_('[Orchestrator] 阶段5: 校验子进程退出状态');
3439        $this->sendStopProgress('阶段5/6: 校验子进程退出状态');
3440        $this->verifyAndKillRemainingProcesses();
3441
3442        // ========== 阶段 6：关闭 IPC 服务器 ==========
3443        $this->setStopStage(self::STOP_STAGE_CLOSE_IPC);
3444        WlsLogger::info_('[Orchestrator] 阶段6: 关闭 IPC 服务器');
3445        $this->sendStopProgress('阶段6/6: 关闭 IPC 服务器');
3446        
3447        // 不提前移除 Master PID 索引，避免外部将“索引消失”误判为“进程已退出”。
3448        // 索引交由 Master 进程最终退出阶段统一清理。
3449        $this->sendStopProgress('所有子进程已完整退出，Master 即将退出进程');
3450        
3451        // 先设置状态，再关闭 IPC（关闭后无法再发送消息）
3452        $this->running = false;
3453        WlsLogger::info_('[Orchestrator] 所有服务已停止');
3454        $this->setStopStage(self::STOP_STAGE_COMPLETE);
3455        
3456        // 最后关闭 IPC
3457        $this->closeIpcServer('stop_all:' . $reason);
3458        $this->finalizeStopAllMasterExit();
3459    }

3461    protected function finalizeStopAllMasterExit(): void

3468    /**
3469     * 重复终止信号或停机卡死时的兜底：按注册表 PID 批量强杀子进程后关闭 IPC 并退出 Master。
3470     * 不依赖正在进行的优雅停机流程是否可恢复。
3471     */
3472    public function forceTerminateMasterAndChildren(string $reason = 'force'): void
3473    {
3474        WlsLogger::warning_("[Orchestrator] 强制终止 Master 及子进程，原因: {$reason}，阶段: {$this->stopStage}");
3475        if ($this->controlServer !== null) {
3476            try {
3477                $this->broadcastDrainToAll();
3478                $this->broadcastShutdownToAll();
3479                $quickFlush = (float) ($this->context?->getConfig('wls.orchestrator.force_stop_ipc_flush_sec', 0.5) ?? 0.5);
3480                if ($quickFlush > 0.0) {
3481                    $this->controlServer->flushPendingWrites(\min(2.0, $quickFlush));
3482                }
3483                $this->pollStopFlowIpc(0, 100000);
3484            } catch (\Throwable $e) {
3485                WlsLogger::warning_('[Orchestrator] 强制停机前 IPC 通知失败: ' . $e->getMessage());
3486            }
3487        }
3488        $pids = [];
3489        foreach ($this->registry->getAllInstances() as $instance) {
3490            if ($instance->pid > 0 && !$this->isExternallyManagedSharedInstance($instance)) {
3491                $pids[] = $instance->pid;
3492            }
3493        }
3494        if ($pids !== []) {
3495            Processer::batchGracefulKill(\array_values(\array_unique($pids)), 0.0, true);
3496        }
3497        $postKillWait = (float) ($this->context?->getConfig('wls.orchestrator.force_stop_ipc_post_kill_wait_sec', 0.35) ?? 0.35);
3498        if ($postKillWait > 0.0 && $this->controlServer !== null) {
3499            $deadline = \microtime(true) + \min(1.5, $postKillWait);
3500            while (\microtime(true) < $deadline
3501                && ($this->controlServer->countServiceClients($this->stopProgressClientId) > 0)) {
3502                $this->pollStopFlowIpc(0, 50000);
3503            }
3504        }
3505        $this->closeIpcServer('force_terminate:' . $reason);
3506        $this->cleanupMasterPidIndex();
3507        exit(2);
3508    }

3554    /**
3555     * 广播 DRAIN 给所有实例
3556     */

3558    {

3560        if ($this->controlServer === null) {
3561            return;
3562        }

3564            if ($instance->ipcClientId === null) {
3565                continue;

3567            if ($this->isExternallyManagedSharedInstance($instance)) {

3569            }
3570            $provider = $this->registry->getProvider($instance->role);
3571            if ($provider === null || !$provider->supportsDrain()) {
3572                continue;
3573            }

3579            // report global draining_complete.

3581        }
3582        
3583        if (!empty($connectedClients)) {
3584            WlsLogger::info_('[IPC] DRAIN -> ' . \implode(', ', $connectedClients));
3585        }

3596        }

3598            if ($instance->ipcClientId === null) {
3599                continue;
3600            }
3601            if ($this->isExternallyManagedSharedInstance($instance)) {
3602                continue;
3603            }
3604            $provider = $this->registry->getProvider($instance->role);
3605            if ($provider === null || !$provider->supportsShutdown()) {
3606                continue;
3607            }

3619    /**

3625        foreach ($this->registry->getAllInstances() as $instance) {
3626            if ($instance->pid <= 0 || $this->isExternallyManagedSharedInstance($instance)) {
3627                continue;
3628            }
3629
3630            // stopAll 第 3 阶段只兜底处理已经脱离 IPC 管理的残留进程。

3634            }
3635        }

3639        }
3640
3641        $pidList = \array_values($candidatePids);

3646            if (!($result[$pid] ?? false)) {

3648            }
3649        }
3650        if (!empty($failed)) {

3653        }

3658    /**
3659     * 等待所有实例排水完成
3660     * 
3661     * @param float $timeout 超时时间（秒）
3662     * @param bool $reportProgress 是否报告进度
3663     */

3665    {

3667        $drainedInstances = [];
3668        $lastHeartbeatAt = 0.0;
3669        $heartbeatInterval = 5.0;
3670        
3671        while (\microtime(true) - $start < $timeout) {
3672            $this->controlServer?->poll(0, 100000);
3673
3674            $drainingCount = 0;
3675            foreach ($this->registry->getAllInstances() as $instance) {
3676                $key = "{$instance->role}#{$instance->instanceId}";
3677                
3678                if ($instance->state === ServiceInstance::STATE_DRAINING
3679                    && $this->isProcessRunning($instance->pid)
3680                ) {
3681                    $drainingCount++;
3682                } elseif ($instance->state !== ServiceInstance::STATE_DRAINING 
3683                          && !isset($drainedInstances[$key])
3684                          && $reportProgress) {
3685                    // 实例已完成排水
3686                    $drainedInstances[$key] = true;
3687                    $provider = $this->registry->getProvider($instance->role);
3688                    $displayName = $provider?->getDisplayName() ?? $instance->role;
3689                    $msg = "  ✓ {$displayName}(PID:{$instance->pid}) 排水完成";
3690                    $this->sendStopProgress($msg);
3691                }
3692            }
3693
3694            if ($reportProgress && $drainingCount > 0) {
3695                $now = \microtime(true);
3696                if (($now - $lastHeartbeatAt) >= $heartbeatInterval) {
3697                    $elapsed = (int)\round($now - $start);
3698                    $this->sendStopProgress("Stage2 waiting for drain: {$drainingCount} remaining ({$elapsed}s/{$timeout}s)");
3699                    $lastHeartbeatAt = $now;
3700                }
3701            }
3702
3703            if ($drainingCount === 0) {
3704                WlsLogger::info_('[Orchestrator] 所有实例排水完成');
3705                if ($reportProgress) {
3706                    $this->sendStopProgress('所有子进程排水完成');
3707                }
3708                return;
3709            }
3710        }
3711        WlsLogger::warning_("[Orchestrator] 等待排水超时 ({$timeout}s)");
3712        if ($reportProgress) {
3713            $this->sendStopProgress("等待排水超时 ({$timeout}s)，继续执行停止流程");
3714        }
3715    }

3724            $timeout = 0.5;
3725        }

3727            $timeout = 120.0;
3728        }

3737    /**
3738     * 等待所有 IPC 连接断开（带进度报告）
3739     */
3740    private function waitForAllDisconnectedWithProgress(float $timeout): void
3741    {
3742        $start = \microtime(true);
3743        $lastClientCount = -1;
3744        $exitedInstances = [];
3745        $lastHeartbeatAt = 0.0;
3746        $heartbeatInterval = 5.0;
3747
3748        while (\microtime(true) - $start < $timeout) {
3749            $this->pollStopFlowIpc(0, 100000);
3750
3751            $clientCount = $this->controlServer?->countServiceClients($this->stopProgressClientId) ?? 0;
3752
3753            if ($clientCount > 0) {
3754                $now = \microtime(true);
3755                if (($now - $lastHeartbeatAt) >= $heartbeatInterval) {
3756                    $elapsed = (int)\round($now - $start);
3757                    $this->sendStopProgress("阶段4: 仍有 {$clientCount} 条子服务 IPC 连接，已等待 {$elapsed}s / {$timeout}s");
3758                    $lastHeartbeatAt = $now;
3759                }
3760            }
3761
3762            // 检查每个实例的退出状态
3763            foreach ($this->registry->getAllInstances() as $instance) {
3764                $key = "{$instance->role}#{$instance->instanceId}";
3765                if (isset($exitedInstances[$key])) {
3766                    continue;
3767                }
3768                
3769                // 检查进程是否已退出
3770                if ($instance->pid > 0 && !$this->isProcessRunning($instance->pid)) {
3771                    $exitedInstances[$key] = true;
3772                    $provider = $this->registry->getProvider($instance->role);
3773                    $displayName = $provider?->getDisplayName() ?? $instance->role;
3774                    $msg = "  ✓ {$displayName}(PID:{$instance->pid}) 已退出";
3775                    WlsLogger::info_("[Orchestrator] {$msg}");
3776                    $this->sendStopProgress($msg);
3777                    // 进程已退出，主动关闭 IPC 连接，避免超时等待
3778                    if ($instance->ipcClientId !== null && $this->controlServer !== null) {
3779                        $this->controlServer->closeClient($instance->ipcClientId);
3780                    }
3781                }
3782            }
3783
3784            // 只在子服务连接数变化时记录日志
3785            if ($clientCount !== $lastClientCount) {
3786                if ($clientCount > 0) {
3787                    WlsLogger::info_("[IPC] 等待子服务断开: 剩余 {$clientCount} 条连接...");
3788                }
3789                $lastClientCount = $clientCount;
3790            }
3791
3792            if ($clientCount === 0) {
3793                $elapsed = \round((\microtime(true) - $start) * 1000);
3794                WlsLogger::info_("[IPC] 所有子服务 IPC 已断开 ({$elapsed}ms)");
3795                $this->sendStopProgress('阶段4完成: 全部子服务 IPC 已断开');
3796                return;
3797            }
3798            // 下一轮循环顶部 pollStopFlowIpc 即等待；此处不再叠原生 usleep
3799        }
3800        $remainingCount = $this->controlServer?->countServiceClients($this->stopProgressClientId) ?? 0;
3801        WlsLogger::warning_("[IPC] 等待子服务断开超时 ({$timeout}s)，剩余 {$remainingCount} 条连接");
3802    }

3812    /**

3818    {
3819        $allInstances = $this->registry->getAllInstances();
3820        $pidToInstance = [];
3821        $connectedVerificationPids = [];
3822        $immediateForceKillPids = [];
3823
3824        foreach ($allInstances as $instance) {
3825            if ($instance->pid <= 0 || $this->isExternallyManagedSharedInstance($instance)) {
3826                continue;
3827            }
3828
3829            $pidToInstance[$instance->pid] = $instance;
3830        }
3831
3832        $initialRunningStatus = $this->batchCheckStopFlowRunning(\array_keys($pidToInstance));
3833        foreach ($pidToInstance as $pid => $instance) {
3834            if (!($initialRunningStatus[$pid] ?? false)) {
3835                if ($instance->ipcClientId !== null) {
3836                    $this->closeStopFlowClient($instance->ipcClientId);
3837                }
3838                continue;
3839            }
3840
3841            if ($this->shouldWaitForStopFlowExitVerification($instance)) {
3842                $connectedVerificationPids[] = $pid;
3843            } else {
3844                $immediateForceKillPids[] = $pid;
3845            }
3846        }
3847
3848        $runningPids = $connectedVerificationPids;
3849
3850        $verificationTimeout = $this->getStopVerificationTimeout();
3851        if (!empty($runningPids) && $verificationTimeout > 0.0) {
3852            $verificationStartedAt = \microtime(true);
3853            $deadline = $verificationStartedAt + $verificationTimeout;
3854            $lastHeartbeatAt = 0.0;
3855
3856            while (!empty($runningPids) && \microtime(true) < $deadline) {
3857                $this->pollStopFlowIpc(0, 100000);
3858
3859                $runningStatus = $this->batchCheckStopFlowRunning($runningPids);
3860                $stillRunning = [];
3861                foreach ($runningPids as $pid) {
3862                    if ($runningStatus[$pid] ?? false) {
3863                        $stillRunning[] = $pid;
3864                        continue;
3865                    }
3866
3867                    $instance = $pidToInstance[$pid] ?? null;
3868                    if ($instance?->ipcClientId !== null) {
3869                        $this->closeStopFlowClient($instance->ipcClientId);
3870                    }
3871                }
3872                $runningPids = $stillRunning;
3873
3874                if ($runningPids === []) {
3875                    break;
3876                }
3877
3878                $now = \microtime(true);
3879                if (($now - $lastHeartbeatAt) >= 1.0) {
3880                    $elapsed = (int) \round($now - $verificationStartedAt);
3881                    $remainingCount = \count($runningPids);
3882                    $this->sendStopProgress("阶段5校验中: 剩余 {$remainingCount} 个进程 ({$elapsed}s/{$verificationTimeout}s)");
3883                    $lastHeartbeatAt = $now;
3884                }
3885
3886                $this->sleepStopFlow(100000);
3887            }
3888        }
3889
3890        if ($immediateForceKillPids !== []) {
3891            $runningPids = \array_values(\array_unique(\array_merge($runningPids, $immediateForceKillPids)));
3892        }
3893
3894        $runningPidSet = [];
3895        foreach ($runningPids as $pid) {
3896            $runningPidSet[$pid] = true;
3897        }
3898
3899        $totalCount = \count($allInstances);
3900        $exitedCount = 0;
3901        foreach ($allInstances as $instance) {
3902            if ($instance->pid <= 0 || !isset($runningPidSet[$instance->pid])) {
3903                $exitedCount++;
3904            }
3905        }
3906        $runningCount = \count($runningPids);
3907
3908        if ($runningCount === 0) {
3909            $this->sendStopProgress("阶段5完成: 全部 {$totalCount} 个子进程已退出");
3910            WlsLogger::info_("[Orchestrator] 阶段5完成: 全部 {$totalCount} 个子进程已退出");
3911        } else {
3912            $this->sendStopProgress("阶段5结果: {$exitedCount}/{$totalCount} 已退出，{$runningCount} 个需强制终止");
3913            WlsLogger::warning_("[Orchestrator] 阶段5结果: {$exitedCount}/{$totalCount} 已退出，{$runningCount} 个需强制终止");
3914        }
3915
3916        if ($runningPids !== []) {
3917            $pidList = [];
3918            foreach ($runningPids as $pid) {
3919                $inst = $pidToInstance[$pid] ?? null;
3920                if ($inst) {
3921                    $provider = $this->registry->getProvider($inst->role);
3922                    $displayName = $provider?->getDisplayName() ?? $inst->role;
3923                    $pidList[] = "{$displayName}(PID:{$pid})";
3924                } else {
3925                    $pidList[] = "PID:{$pid}";
3926                }
3927            }
3928
3929            $this->sendStopProgress('强制终止残留进程: ' . \implode(', ', $pidList));
3930            WlsLogger::warning_('[Orchestrator] 强制终止残留子进程: ' . \implode(',', $runningPids));
3931            $result = $this->forceStopRemainingProcesses($runningPids);
3932
3933            foreach ($runningPids as $pid) {
3934                $instance = $pidToInstance[$pid] ?? null;
3935                if ($instance?->ipcClientId !== null) {
3936                    $this->closeStopFlowClient($instance->ipcClientId);
3937                }
3938            }
3939
3940            if ($result['killed'] > 0) {
3941                $this->sendStopProgress("  ✓ 已强制终止 {$result['killed']} 个残留进程");
3942                WlsLogger::info_("[Orchestrator] 已强制终止 {$result['killed']} 个残留子进程");
3943            }
3944            if (!empty($result['remaining'])) {
3945                $remainingCount = \count($result['remaining']);
3946                $this->sendStopProgress('  ! 仍有 ' . $remainingCount . ' 个进程未终止: ' . \implode(',', $result['remaining']));
3947                WlsLogger::warning_('[Orchestrator] 仍有 ' . $remainingCount . ' 个进程未终止: ' . \implode(',', $result['remaining']));
3948            }
3949        }
3950
3951        foreach ($allInstances as $instance) {
3952            $this->cleanupInstancePidFile($instance);
3953            $instance->state = ServiceInstance::STATE_STOPPED;
3954            $this->registry->updateInstance($instance);
3955
3956            $provider = $this->registry->getProvider($instance->role);
3957            $provider?->onStopped($instance);
3958        }
3959    }

3961    /**

3966        // IPC 连接仍在时，说明子进程仍处于协议管理内，阶段 5 可以给一小段优雅退出窗口。

3968        if ($instance->ipcClientId === null) {
3969            return false;
3970        }
3971
3972        if ($instance->role === ControlMessage::ROLE_DISPATCHER
3973            && $instance->state === ServiceInstance::STATE_STOPPING) {
3974            return false;
3975        }
3976
3977        return true;
3978    }

4596    /**

4607        if ($n === 0) {

4610        if ($forceSingleBatch) {
4611            return [\array_map('intval', $orderedInstanceIds)];

4613        $minThree = (int) ($this->context?->getConfig('wls.orchestrator.worker_three_batch_min_count', 7) ?? 7);

4617        if ($n < $minThree) {
4618            $out = [];
4619            foreach ($orderedInstanceIds as $id) {
4620                $out[] = [(int) $id];
4621            }
4622
4623            return $out;
4624        }
4625        $base = intdiv($n, 3);

4638        return $batches;

5380    private function waitForWorkerCriticalInfraReady(string $operationLabel, ?float $timeoutSec = null): bool
5381    {

5398        try {

5412                    $this->reconcileRoleSlotGaps($role);
5413                }
5414
5415                $missingRoles = $this->collectWorkerCriticalInfraNotReadyRoles($criticalRoles);
5416                if ($missingRoles === []) {
5417                    WlsLogger::info_('[Orchestrator] ' . $operationLabel . ' resumed after critical infra recovered');
5418
5419                    return true;
5420                }
5421
5422                $now = \microtime(true);
5423                if (($now - $lastHeartbeatAt) >= 5.0) {
5424                    WlsLogger::info_(

5426                        . $operationLabel
5427                        . ' still waiting for critical infra READY: '
5428                        . \implode(',', $missingRoles)
5429                    );

5431                }

5435        }

5437        WlsLogger::error_(
5438            '[Orchestrator] '
5439            . $operationLabel
5440            . ' timed out waiting for critical infra READY: '
5441            . \implode(',', $missingRoles)
5442        );

5447    /**
5448     * 可中断等待：在 runLoop 的 Fiber 内用协作式 usleep；在主栈（如启动阶段）仅用控制面 poll，避免原生 sleep 期间无法读 IPC。
5449     */
5450    private function sleepInterruptiblyForPeriodicWork(int $microseconds, int $sliceMicroseconds = 50000): bool
5451    {
5452        if ($microseconds <= 0) {
5453            return !$this->shouldYieldPeriodicWork(true);
5454        }
5455
5456        $inFiber = SchedulerSystem::isSchedulerActive() && \Fiber::getCurrent() !== null;
5457        $deadline = \microtime(true) + ($microseconds / 1000000);
5458        while (\microtime(true) < $deadline) {
5459            if ($this->shouldYieldPeriodicWork(true)) {
5460                return false;
5461            }
5462
5463            $remainingUsec = (int)\max(1, ($deadline - \microtime(true)) * 1000000);
5464            $slice = \min($sliceMicroseconds, $remainingUsec);
5465            if ($inFiber) {
5466                SchedulerSystem::usleep($slice);
5467            } else {
5468                $this->pollControlPlaneBlockingUsec($slice);
5469            }
5470        }
5471
5472        return !$this->shouldYieldPeriodicWork(true);
5473    }

5487            $u = 5000;
5488        }
5489        if ($u > 500000) {
5490            $u = 500000;
5491        }
5492
5493        return $u;
5494    }

5502            $this->controlServer?->poll(0, 0);
5503

5509    /**
5510     * 启动宽限期（秒）- 在此期间不对新启动的进程进行健康检查
5511     */
5512    private float $startupGracePeriod = 60.0;
5513
5514    /**
5515     * 执行健康检查
5516     *
5517     * 健康检查策略：
5518     * 1. 启动中的实例：只检查是否超过启动宽限期
5519     * 2. 运行中的实例：优先检查 IPC 连接状态，其次检查 PID

5521     */
5522    private function performHealthChecks(): void
5523    {
5524        if ($this->isRecoverySuspended()) {
5525            return;
5526        }
5527
5528        $now = \microtime(true);
5529        $lastYieldAt = $now;
5530        $providers = $this->registry->getAllProviders();
5531
5532        foreach ($providers as $provider) {
5533            $this->cooperativeYieldIfNeeded($lastYieldAt);
5534            if ($this->shouldYieldPeriodicWork(true)) {
5535                return;
5536            }
5537            $instances = $this->registry->getInstancesByRole($provider->getRole());
5538            foreach ($instances as $instance) {
5539                $this->cooperativeYieldIfNeeded($lastYieldAt);
5540                if ($this->shouldYieldPeriodicWork(true)) {
5541                    return;
5542                }
5543                if ($this->childServicesBootstrapInProgress
5544                    && \in_array($instance->role, [ControlMessage::ROLE_WORKER, ControlMessage::ROLE_MAINTENANCE], true)) {
5545                    continue;
5546                }
5547                if ($instance->state === ServiceInstance::STATE_FAILED ||
5548                    $instance->state === ServiceInstance::STATE_STOPPED) {
5549                    continue;
5550                }
5551
5552                $uptime = $now - $instance->startedAt;
5553
5554                // 启动中的实例：在宽限期内不检查
5555                if ($instance->state === ServiceInstance::STATE_STARTING) {
5556                    // 尚未连上 IPC 且子进程已死 → 不等到 register 超时，立即拉起
5557                    if ($instance->ipcClientId === null
5558                        && $instance->pid > 0
5559                        && !$this->isProcessRunning($instance->pid)
5560                        && \in_array($instance->role, [ControlMessage::ROLE_WORKER, ControlMessage::ROLE_MAINTENANCE], true)
5561                        && ($provider->getResurrectionPriority() > 0)) {
5562                        WlsLogger::warning_(
5563                            "[Orchestrator] {$instance->role}#{$instance->instanceId} 未建立 IPC 且 PID 已退出，立即拉起"
5564                        );
5565                        $this->scheduleResurrectionWithDelay($instance, 0.0);
5566                        continue;
5567                    }
5568                    // 启动确认超时（register/ready 未到）
5569                    $registerTimeoutSec = $this->getRegisterTimeoutForRole($instance->role);
5570                    if ($instance->ipcClientId === null && $uptime >= $registerTimeoutSec) {
5571                        $this->registerTimeoutCount++;
5572                        WlsLogger::warning_(
5573                            "[Orchestrator] register 超时: {$instance->role}#{$instance->instanceId} "
5574                            . "(uptime={$uptime}s, timeout={$registerTimeoutSec}s)"
5575                        );
5576                        $this->healthCheckRestartOrEscalate($instance, "register_timeout:{$instance->role}#{$instance->instanceId}");
5577                        continue;
5578                    }
5579
5580                    if ($uptime < $this->startupGracePeriod) {
5581                        if ($instance->ipcClientId !== null) {
5582                            // 仅建立 IPC 连接并不代表子进程已经显式 READY。
5583                            // 提前标记 READY 会让 maintenance / business worker 在真正可服务前错误入池。
5584                            $instance->lastHealthCheck = $now;
5585                            $this->registry->updateInstance($instance);
5586                        }
5587                        continue;
5588                    }
5589                    // 宽限期已过但还没有 IPC 连接
5590                    if ($instance->ipcClientId === null) {
5591                        WlsLogger::warning_("[Orchestrator] 启动超时: {$instance->role}#{$instance->instanceId} (uptime={$uptime}s, no IPC)");
5592                        $this->healthCheckRestartOrEscalate($instance, "startup_timeout:{$instance->role}#{$instance->instanceId}");
5593                        continue;
5594                    }
5595                }
5596
5597                // 运行中的实例：检查 IPC 连接状态
5598                // 优先以 IPC 连接判断存活（Windows 下 PID 可能不准确）
5599                if ($instance->ipcClientId !== null) {
5600                    // 有 IPC 连接，视为健康
5601                    $result = $provider->healthCheck($instance);
5602                    $instance->lastHealthCheck = $now;
5603                    if (!$result->isHealthy()) {
5604                        WlsLogger::warning_(
5605                            "[Master自检] 子进程健康检查异常: {$instance->role}#{$instance->instanceId} — {$result->message}"
5606                        );
5607                    }
5608                    $this->registry->updateInstance($instance);
5609                    continue;
5610                }
5611
5612                // 没有 IPC 连接，检查 PID（作为备用方案）
5613                if ($this->isExternallyManagedSharedInstance($instance)) {
5614                    if ($this->isExternallyManagedSharedInstanceAlive($instance)) {
5615                        $instance->lastHealthCheck = $now;
5616                        $this->registry->updateInstance($instance);
5617                        continue;
5618                    }
5619
5620                    WlsLogger::warning_(
5621                        "[Orchestrator] 外部共享 sidecar 不可用，切换为本实例接管: {$instance->role}#{$instance->instanceId}"
5622                    );
5623                    $this->infraDegraded[$instance->role] = true;
5624                    $this->broadcastRoutingPolicyToWorkers();
5625                    $this->healthCheckRestartOrEscalate(
5626                        $instance,
5627                        "shared_external_unavailable:{$instance->role}#{$instance->instanceId}"
5628                    );
5629                    continue;
5630                }
5631
5632                if ($instance->pid > 0 && $this->isProcessRunning($instance->pid)) {
5633                    // PID 存活但没有 IPC 连接，可能正在启动或重连
5634                    if ($uptime < $this->startupGracePeriod * 2) {
5635                        continue;
5636                    }
5637                    // 超过宽限期仍没有 IPC 连接，视为僵尸进程，需要杀死并复活
5638                    WlsLogger::warning_("[Orchestrator] 进程存活但无 IPC 超时: {$instance->role}#{$instance->instanceId} (pid={$instance->pid}, uptime={$uptime}s)");
5639                    $this->healthCheckRestartOrEscalate($instance, "no_ipc_timeout:{$instance->role}#{$instance->instanceId}");
5640                    continue;
5641                }
5642
5643                // 既没有 IPC 连接，PID 也不存活
5644                WlsLogger::warning_("[Orchestrator] 健康检查失败: {$instance->role}#{$instance->instanceId} - No IPC and PID not running");
5645                $this->healthCheckRestartOrEscalate($instance, "dead_without_ipc:{$instance->role}#{$instance->instanceId}");
5646            }
5647        }
5648    }

5650    /**
5651     * 健康检查触发的重启：凡可复活的子进程均单槽拉起；仅无复活优先级或单槽重启耗尽时整组重启。
5652     */
5653    private function healthCheckRestartOrEscalate(ServiceInstance $instance, string $reason): void
5654    {
5655        if ($this->isRecoverySuspended()) {
5656            return;
5657        }
5658        WlsLogger::warning_(
5659            '[Orchestrator] 健康检查触发复活决策: reason=' . $reason . ', ' . $this->formatInstanceDebugContext($instance)
5660        );
5661
5662        if ($this->preserveExternallyManagedSharedInstance($instance, $reason)) {
5663            return;
5664        }
5665
5666        // 外部复用的 shared sidecar 可能长期无法与当前 Master 建立 IPC（例如 Master 重启/代际切换）。
5667        // 只要进程仍存活，就不应触发本地 kill + resurrect，否则会在复用场景下形成“误复活风暴”。
5668        if ($this->isExternallyManagedSharedInstance($instance)
5669            && \str_starts_with($reason, 'no_ipc_timeout:')
5670            && $instance->pid > 0
5671            && $this->isProcessRunning($instance->pid)
5672        ) {
5673            $instance->lastHealthCheck = \microtime(true);
5674            $this->registry->updateInstance($instance);
5675            WlsLogger::info_(
5676                "[Orchestrator] 跳过外部共享服务复活：进程仍存活但无 IPC（原因={$reason}）{$instance->role}#{$instance->instanceId} (pid={$instance->pid})"
5677            );
5678            return;
5679        }
5680
5681        $maxRestarts = 10;
5682        $provider = $this->registry->getProvider($instance->role);
5683        if ($this->cleanupInactiveMaintenanceInstance($instance, '健康检查失败')) {
5684            return;
5685        }
5686        if (!$this->canUseLocalSlotResurrection($instance, $provider)) {
5687            $this->requestFullRestart($reason);
5688
5689            return;
5690        }
5691        if ($instance->restarts >= $maxRestarts) {
5692            $this->requestFullRestart("{$reason} (max_slot_restarts={$instance->restarts})");
5693
5694            return;
5695        }
5696
5697        if ($instance->pid > 0 && $this->isProcessRunning($instance->pid)) {
5698            $this->killInstanceProcess($instance);
5699            if (!$this->sleepInterruptiblyForPeriodicWork(200000)) {
5700                return;
5701            }
5702        }
5703        $this->scheduleResurrection($instance);
5704    }

5706    private function canUseLocalSlotResurrection(
5707        ServiceInstance $instance,
5708        ?ServiceProviderInterface $provider = null
5709    ): bool {
5710        $provider ??= $this->registry->getProvider($instance->role);
5711        if ($provider === null) {
5712            return false;
5713        }
5714
5715        if ($instance->getUptime() < $this->startupGracePeriod) {
5716            return true;
5717        }

5719        if ($provider->getResurrectionPriority() > 0) {
5720            return true;
5721        }

5723        return $instance->role === ControlMessage::ROLE_MAINTENANCE
5724            && $this->maintenanceMode;

5889        return 'instance=' . $instance->role . '#' . $instance->instanceId
5890            . ', state=' . $instance->state
5891            . ', pid=' . $instance->pid
5892            . ', pid_alive=' . $pidAlive
5893            . ', ipc=' . ($instance->ipcClientId !== null ? (string) $instance->ipcClientId : 'null')
5894            . ', restarts=' . $instance->restarts
5895            . ', uptime=' . \number_format($instance->getUptime(), 2, '.', '') . 's'
5896            . ', launch_id=' . ($instance->launchId !== '' ? $instance->launchId : 'null');

5899    /**
5900     * 请求整组重启（防止孤儿进程累积）
5901     */
5902    private function logStartupTiming(
5903        ServiceInstance $instance,
5904        string $milestone,
5905        array $extra = [],
5906        string $level = 'info'
5907    ): void {
5908        if (!isset($extra['spawn_transport'])) {
5909            $spawnTransport = $instance->getMeta('spawn_transport');
5910            if (\is_string($spawnTransport) && $spawnTransport !== '') {
5911                $extra['spawn_transport'] = $spawnTransport;
5912            }
5913        }
5914        if (!isset($extra['spawn_cost_ms'])) {
5915            $spawnCostMs = $instance->getMeta('spawn_cost_ms');
5916            if ($spawnCostMs !== null) {
5917                $extra['spawn_cost_ms'] = $spawnCostMs;
5918            }
5919        }
5920
5921        $parts = ["[Orchestrator][StartupTiming] {$milestone}", $this->formatInstanceDebugContext($instance)];
5922        foreach ($extra as $key => $value) {
5923            if ($value === null || $value === '') {
5924                continue;
5925            }
5926            $parts[] = $key . '=' . $this->formatStartupTimingValue($value);
5927        }
5928
5929        $message = \implode(', ', $parts);
5930        if ($level === 'warning') {
5931            WlsLogger::warning_($message);
5932            return;
5933        }
5934
5935        WlsLogger::info_($message);
5936    }

5938    private function formatStartupTimingValue(mixed $value): string
5939    {
5940        if ($value === null) {
5941            return 'null';
5942        }
5943        if (\is_bool($value)) {
5944            return $value ? '1' : '0';
5945        }
5946        if (\is_float($value)) {
5947            return \number_format($value, 2, '.', '');
5948        }
5949        if (\is_scalar($value)) {
5950            return (string) $value;
5951        }
5952
5953        return \json_encode($value, \JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | \JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES) ?: \get_debug_type($value);
5954    }

5956    private function requestFullRestart(string $reason): void
5957    {
5958        if (!$this->haMode || !$this->fullRestartOnFailure || $this->isStopFlowActive()) {
5959            return;
5960        }
5961
5962        $now = \microtime(true);
5963        if (($now - $this->lastFullRestartAt) < $this->fullRestartCooldown) {
5964            WlsLogger::warning_("[Orchestrator] 忽略频繁整组重启请求（冷却中）: {$reason}");
5965            return;
5966        }
5967
5968        if ($this->fullRestartRequested) {
5969            return;
5970        }
5971
5972        $this->fullRestartRequested = true;
5973        $this->fullRestartReason = $reason;
5974        WlsLogger::warning_("[Orchestrator] 已标记整组重启，原因: {$reason}");
5975    }
