5977    /**
5978     * 执行整组重启：先停全量，再重新拉起
5979     */
5980    private function performFullRestart(): void
5981    {
5982        if ($this->context === null) {
5983            WlsLogger::error_('[Orchestrator] 缺少 context，无法执行整组重启');
5984            $this->fullRestartRequested = false;
5985            return;
5986        }
5987        $this->fullRestartCount++;
5988
5989        $reason = $this->fullRestartReason !== '' ? $this->fullRestartReason : 'unknown';
5990        $this->fullRestartRequested = false;
5991        $this->fullRestartReason = '';
5992        $this->lastFullRestartAt = \microtime(true);
5993
5994        WlsLogger::warning_("[Orchestrator] 开始执行整组重启，原因: {$reason}");
5995
5996        // 1) 仅停止子进程（不关闭 IPC 服务器、不设 shuttingDown/running=false）
5997        $this->stopChildProcesses("full_restart:{$reason}");
5998
5999        // 2) 扫尾清理：按前缀清理逃逸子进程，防止窗口与孤儿进程累积
6000        $this->cleanupOrphanChildProcesses(aggressiveKill: true);
6001
6002        // 3) 清空注册表实例索引，避免残留实例污染新一轮生命周期
6003        $this->registry->clearInstances();
6004        $this->resurrectQueue = [];
6005        $this->resetServerReadyNotificationState();
6006
6007        // 4) bump epoch，旧代际进程即使迟到注册也会被拒绝
6008        $nextEpoch = $this->context->epoch + 1;
6009        $this->context = $this->context->withEpoch($nextEpoch);
6010        WlsLogger::warning_("[Orchestrator] 代际切换到 epoch={$nextEpoch}");
6011
6012        // 5) 重新拉起全量服务（仅子进程，不重新初始化 IPC 服务器）
6013        $this->restartChildProcesses($this->context);
6014
6015        // 更新重启完成时间（确保冷却期从完成时开始计算）
6016        $this->lastFullRestartAt = \microtime(true);
6017
6018        WlsLogger::warning_('[Orchestrator] 整组重启完成');
6019        $this->suppressWorkerEmergencyUntil = \microtime(true) + 30.0;
6020    }

6099    {

6101            return;

6103        $label = $this->ipcExclusiveCommand ?? '';

6121        }

6124            $this->rollingRestartProgress = 0;
6125            $this->rollingRestartTotal = 0;

6130                );
6131            }
6132        }

6142    /**
6143     * 仅停止子进程，保持 Master 和 IPC 服务器运行。
6144     * 用于 performFullRestart 场景（停子进程 → 拉新子进程）。
6145     * 与 stopAll 不同：不设 shuttingDown、不设 running=false、不关闭 IPC。
6146     */
6147    private function stopChildProcesses(string $reason): void
6148    {
6149        WlsLogger::info_("[Orchestrator] 开始停止子进程（保持 IPC），原因: {$reason}");
6150        $this->childProcessStopInProgress = true;
6151
6152        try {
6153            $allInstances = $this->registry->getAllInstances();
6154            if (\count($allInstances) === 0) {
6155                WlsLogger::info_('[Orchestrator] 无运行中的子进程');
6156                return;
6157            }
6158
6159            // 阶段 1：广播 DRAIN
6160            WlsLogger::info_('[Orchestrator] 子进程停止阶段1: 广播 DRAIN');
6161            $this->broadcastDrainToAll();
6162
6163            // 阶段 2：等待排水完成
6164            WlsLogger::info_('[Orchestrator] 子进程停止阶段2: 等待排水完成');
6165            $this->waitForAllDrained($this->drainTimeout, true);
6166
6167            // 阶段 3：广播 SHUTDOWN
6168            WlsLogger::info_('[Orchestrator] 子进程停止阶段3: 广播 SHUTDOWN');
6169            $this->broadcastShutdownToAll();
6170
6171            // 阶段 4：等待子进程 IPC 断开（与 stopAll 阶段 4 一致）
6172            WlsLogger::info_('[Orchestrator] 子进程停止阶段4: 等待子服务 IPC 断开');
6173            $this->waitForServiceIpcDisconnectAfterShutdown();
6174
6175            // 阶段 5：强制杀死残留子进程
6176            WlsLogger::info_('[Orchestrator] 子进程停止阶段5: 校验并杀死残留');
6177            $this->verifyAndKillRemainingProcesses();
6178
6179            WlsLogger::info_('[Orchestrator] 所有子进程已停止');
6180        } finally {
6181            $this->childProcessStopInProgress = false;
6182        }
6183    }
6184    
6185    /**
6186     * 仅重启子进程（不重新初始化 IPC 控制服务器）
6187     * 
6188     * 用于 performFullRestart 场景，此时 Master 和 IPC 服务器仍在运行，
6189     * 只需要重新启动子进程（Worker、Dispatcher 等）。
6190     */
6191    private function restartChildProcesses(ServiceContext $context): void
6192    {
6193        // 按优先级启动服务
6194        $providers = $this->registry->getAllProviders();
6195        $startedCount = 0;
6196
6197        foreach ($providers as $provider) {
6198            if (!$provider->isEnabled($context)) {
6199                WlsLogger::debug_("[Orchestrator] 服务 {$provider->getRole()} 未启用，跳过");
6200                continue;
6201            }
6202
6203            $instanceCount = $provider->getInstanceCount($context);
6204            $role = $provider->getRole();
6205            $displayName = $provider->getDisplayName();
6206            $this->desiredState[$role] = $instanceCount;
6207
6208            WlsLogger::info_("[Orchestrator] 重启服务 {$displayName} (role={$role}, instances={$instanceCount})");
6209
6210            for ($i = 1; $i <= $instanceCount; $i++) {
6211                $instance = $this->startInstance($provider, $i, $context);
6212                if ($instance !== null) {
6213                    $startedCount++;
6214                    
6215                    // 启动后立即 poll IPC，处理子进程的连接和注册消息
6216                    $this->controlServer?->poll(0, 100000);
6217                }
6218            }
6219            
6220            // 每个服务类型启动完毕后额外 poll 一次
6221            $this->controlServer?->poll(0, 200000);
6222        }
6223
6224        WlsLogger::info_("[Orchestrator] 子进程重启完成，共启动 {$startedCount} 个实例");
6225
6226        // 持久化服务实例信息
6227        $this->persistServicesInfo($context);
6228    }

6230    /**
6231     * 按前缀清理逃逸子进程（不处理 Master 自身）
6232     */
6233    private function cleanupOrphanChildProcesses(bool $aggressiveKill = true): void
6234    {
6235        // 周期扫尾默认不做强杀，避免误杀“正在启动但尚未注册”的进程
6236        if (!$aggressiveKill) {
6237            $staleRemoved = Processer::cleanupStalePidFiles();
6238            $this->lastSweepKilled = 0;
6239            $this->lastSweepStalePidFiles = $staleRemoved;
6240            WlsLogger::info_("[Orchestrator] 轻量扫尾完成: killed=0, stale_pid_files={$staleRemoved}");
6241            return;
6242        }
6243
6244        $prefixes = [
6245            'weline-wls-session-',
6246            'weline-wls-worker-',
6247            'weline-wls-dispatcher-',
6248            'weline-wls-redirect-',
6249            'weline-wls-maintenance-',
6250        ];
6251
6252        $killed = 0;
6253        foreach ($prefixes as $prefix) {
6254            $killed += Processer::killByProcessNamePrefix($prefix);
6255        }
6256
6257        $staleRemoved = Processer::cleanupStalePidFiles();
6258        $this->lastSweepKilled = $killed;
6259        $this->lastSweepStalePidFiles = $staleRemoved;
6260        WlsLogger::warning_("[Orchestrator] 子进程扫尾完成: killed={$killed}, stale_pid_files={$staleRemoved}");
6261    }

6263    /**
6264     * 期望状态收敛：确保实例数量与实例槽位一致
6265     */
6266    private function reconcileDesiredState(): void
6267    {
6268        if ($this->context === null || empty($this->desiredState) || $this->isRecoverySuspended()) {
6269            return;
6270        }
6271        if ($this->childServicesBootstrapInProgress) {
6272            WlsLogger::debug_('[Orchestrator] reconcileDesiredState 跳过：子服务 bootstrap 进行中');
6273
6274            return;
6275        }
6276
6277        $lastYieldAt = \microtime(true);
6278        foreach ($this->desiredState as $role => $desiredCount) {
6279            $this->cooperativeYieldIfNeeded($lastYieldAt);
6280            if ($this->shouldYieldPeriodicWork(true)) {
6281                return;
6282            }
6283            $provider = $this->registry->getProvider($role);
6284            if ($provider === null || !$provider->isEnabled($this->context)) {
6285                continue;
6286            }
6287
6288            // 缺失实例补齐
6289            for ($slot = 1; $slot <= $desiredCount; $slot++) {
6290                $this->cooperativeYieldIfNeeded($lastYieldAt);
6291                if ($this->shouldYieldPeriodicWork(true)) {
6292                    return;
6293                }
6294                $queueKey = "{$role}:{$slot}";
6295                if (isset($this->resurrectQueue[$queueKey])) {
6296                    // 已在复活队列（含延迟执行）：勿在此再拉起，否则与 processResurrectQueue 重复 fork 同槽位双进程
6297                    continue;
6298                }
6299                $instance = $this->registry->getInstance($role, $slot);
6300                if ($instance === null || $instance->state === ServiceInstance::STATE_STOPPED || $instance->state === ServiceInstance::STATE_FAILED) {
6301                    WlsLogger::warning_("[Orchestrator] 收敛补齐实例 {$role}#{$slot}");
6302                    $this->registry->removeInstance($role, $slot);
6303                    $this->startInstance($provider, $slot, $this->context);
6304                    continue;
6305                }
6306
6307                // 旧代际实例强制回收
6308                if ($instance->epoch !== $this->context->epoch) {
6309                    WlsLogger::warning_("[Orchestrator] 收敛回收旧代际实例 {$role}#{$slot} (epoch={$instance->epoch} -> {$this->context->epoch})");
6310                    $this->stopInstanceWithProtocol($instance);
6311                    $this->registry->removeInstance($role, $slot);
6312                    $this->startInstance($provider, $slot, $this->context);
6313                }
6314            }
6315
6316            // 超额实例回收
6317            foreach ($this->registry->getInstancesByRole($role) as $instanceId => $instance) {
6318                $this->cooperativeYieldIfNeeded($lastYieldAt);
6319                if ($this->shouldYieldPeriodicWork(true)) {
6320                    return;
6321                }
6322                if ($instanceId <= $desiredCount) {
6323                    continue;
6324                }
6325                WlsLogger::warning_("[Orchestrator] 收敛回收超额实例 {$role}#{$instanceId}");
6326                $this->stopInstanceWithProtocol($instance);
6327                $this->registry->removeInstance($role, $instanceId);
6328            }
6329        }
6330    }

6332    /**
6333     * 安排实例复活
6334     */
6335    private function scheduleResurrection(ServiceInstance $instance): void
6336    {
6337        if ($this->isStopFlowActive()) {
6338            return;
6339        }
6340
6341        $provider = $this->registry->getProvider($instance->role);
6342        if ($provider === null) {
6343            return;
6344        }
6345
6346        if (!$this->canUseLocalSlotResurrection($instance, $provider)) {
6347            WlsLogger::info_("[Orchestrator] 服务 {$instance->role} 不参与本地单槽复活");
6348            return;
6349        }
6350
6351        $key = $instance->getKey();
6352        if (isset($this->resurrectQueue[$key])) {
6353            return;
6354        }
6355
6356        $instance->state = ServiceInstance::STATE_FAILED;
6357        $instance->restarts++;
6358        $this->registry->updateInstance($instance);
6359
6360        $maxRestarts = 10;
6361        if ($instance->restarts > $maxRestarts) {
6362            WlsLogger::error_("[Orchestrator] 服务 {$instance->role}#{$instance->instanceId} 已重启 {$instance->restarts} 次，放弃复活");
6363            return;
6364        }
6365
6366        // 指数退避延迟
6367        $delay = \min(30.0, \pow(2, $instance->restarts - 1));
6368
6369        $this->resurrectQueue[$key] = [
6370            'role' => $instance->role,
6371            'instanceId' => $instance->instanceId,
6372            'maxRestarts' => $maxRestarts,
6373            'restartDelay' => $delay,
6374            'scheduledAt' => \microtime(true) + $delay,
6375        ];
6376
6377        WlsLogger::info_("[Orchestrator] 安排复活 {$instance->role}#{$instance->instanceId}，延迟 {$delay}s");
6378    }

6380    /**
6381     * 处理复活队列
6382     */
6383    /**
6384     * @param string[]|null $roles
6385     */
6386    private function processResurrectQueue(?array $roles = null): void
6387    {
6388        if (empty($this->resurrectQueue) || $this->isRecoverySuspended()) {
6389            return;
6390        }
6391
6392        $now = \microtime(true);
6393        foreach ($this->resurrectQueue as $key => $entry) {
6394            if ($roles !== null && !\in_array((string) ($entry['role'] ?? ''), $roles, true)) {
6395                continue;
6396            }
6397            if ($this->childServicesBootstrapInProgress) {
6398                $entryRole = (string) ($entry['role'] ?? '');
6399                if ($entryRole === ControlMessage::ROLE_WORKER || $entryRole === ControlMessage::ROLE_MAINTENANCE) {
6400                    continue;
6401                }
6402            }
6403            if ($this->shouldYieldPeriodicWork(true)) {
6404                return;
6405            }
6406            if (($entry['role'] ?? '') === ControlMessage::ROLE_MAINTENANCE && !$this->maintenanceMode) {
6407                unset($this->resurrectQueue[$key]);
6408                WlsLogger::info_("[Orchestrator] 维护模式已关闭，取消 maintenance#{$entry['instanceId']} 待执行复活");
6409                continue;
6410            }
6411            if ($now < $entry['scheduledAt']) {
6412                continue;
6413            }
6414
6415            $provider = $this->registry->getProvider($entry['role']);
6416            if ($provider === null) {
6417                unset($this->resurrectQueue[$key]);
6418                continue;
6419            }
6420
6421            // 获取旧实例（在移除前）用于清理和传递 restarts
6422            $oldInstance = $this->registry->getInstance($entry['role'], $entry['instanceId']);
6423            $oldRestarts = $oldInstance?->restarts ?? 0;
6424            $port = (int)($entry['port'] ?? ($oldInstance?->port ?? 0));
6425            if ($oldInstance !== null
6426                && $this->preserveExternallyManagedSharedInstance($oldInstance, 'process_resurrect_queue')
6427            ) {
6428                unset($this->resurrectQueue[$key]);
6429                continue;
6430            }
6431
6432            // 旧实例已经重新连回 Master，取消本次复活
6433            if ($oldInstance !== null
6434                && $oldInstance->ipcClientId !== null
6435                && \in_array($oldInstance->state, [ServiceInstance::STATE_REGISTERED, ServiceInstance::STATE_READY], true)
6436            ) {
6437                WlsLogger::info_("[Orchestrator] {$entry['role']}#{$entry['instanceId']} 已恢复 IPC 连接，取消待执行复活");
6438                unset($this->resurrectQueue[$key]);
6439                continue;
6440            }
6441
6442            if ($oldInstance !== null) {
6443                $slotOccupancy = $this->inspectSlotOccupancy($oldInstance, $entry, $now);
6444                if ($oldInstance->ipcClientId === null
6445                    && $slotOccupancy['freshStartupWindow']
6446                    && ($slotOccupancy['pidAlive'] || $slotOccupancy['trackedPid'] <= 0)) {
6447                    $remainingSec = \max(0.0, $slotOccupancy['startupWindowSec'] - $slotOccupancy['ageSec']);
6448                    $entry['scheduledAt'] = \microtime(true) + 1.0;
6449                    $this->resurrectQueue[$key] = $entry;
6450                    WlsLogger::info_(
6451                        "[Orchestrator] {$entry['role']}#{$entry['instanceId']} 仍处于启动宽限窗口，推迟复活"
6452                        . "（previous_state={$slotOccupancy['previousState']}, pid={$slotOccupancy['trackedPid']}, "
6453                        . 'pid_alive=' . ($slotOccupancy['pidAlive'] ? '1' : '0')
6454                        . ', age=' . \round($slotOccupancy['ageSec'], 3) . 's'
6455                        . ', remaining=' . \round($remainingSec, 3) . 's）'
6456                    );
6457                    continue;
6458                }
6459            }
6460
6461            // 延迟复活：检查进程是否仍在运行
6462            if (!empty($entry['delayed']) && !empty($entry['pid'])) {
6463                if (!$this->terminateStaleProcessBeforeResurrection($oldInstance, (int)$entry['pid'], $port)) {
6464                    $entry['scheduledAt'] = \microtime(true) + 1.0;
6465                    $this->resurrectQueue[$key] = $entry;
6466                    WlsLogger::warning_("[Orchestrator] {$entry['role']}#{$entry['instanceId']} 旧进程/端口尚未释放，1 秒后重试复活");
6467                    continue;
6468                }
6469            }
6470
6471            if (!$this->ensurePortReleasedForResurrection($port)) {
6472                $entry['scheduledAt'] = \microtime(true) + 1.0;
6473                $this->resurrectQueue[$key] = $entry;
6474                WlsLogger::warning_("[Orchestrator] {$entry['role']}#{$entry['instanceId']} 端口 {$port} 仍被占用，推迟复活");
6475                continue;
6476            }
6477
6478            // 清理旧实例的 PID 文件
6479            if ($oldInstance !== null) {
6480                $this->cleanupInstancePidFile($oldInstance);
6481            }
6482
6483            WlsLogger::info_("[Orchestrator] 执行复活 {$entry['role']}#{$entry['instanceId']}");
6484
6485            // 移除旧实例
6486            $this->registry->removeInstance($entry['role'], $entry['instanceId']);
6487
6488            // 启动新实例
6489            $newInstance = $this->startInstance($provider, $entry['instanceId'], $this->context);
6490            if ($newInstance !== null) {
6491                $newInstance->restarts = $oldRestarts;
6492                $this->persistServicesInfo($this->context);
6493            }
6494
6495            $infraBudget = (int) ($entry['infraRetryBudget'] ?? 0);
6496            if ($infraBudget > 0 && $newInstance === null) {
6497                $left = $infraBudget - 1;
6498                if ($left > 0) {
6499                    WlsLogger::warning_(
6500                        "[Orchestrator] {$entry['role']}#{$entry['instanceId']} 复活启动失败，1.5s 后再试（剩余 {$left} 次）"
6501                    );
6502                    $this->resurrectQueue[$key] = [
6503                        'role' => $entry['role'],
6504                        'instanceId' => $entry['instanceId'],
6505                        'maxRestarts' => 10,
6506                        'restartDelay' => 1.5,
6507                        'scheduledAt' => $now + 1.5,
6508                        'delayed' => false,
6509                        'pid' => 0,
6510                        'port' => $port,
6511                        'infraRetryBudget' => $left,
6512                    ];
6513
6514                    continue;
6515                }
6516                unset($this->resurrectQueue[$key]);
6517                WlsLogger::error_("[Orchestrator] {$entry['role']} 本地复活已用尽，触发整组重启");
6518                $this->requestFullRestart("infra_resurrect_exhausted:{$entry['role']}");
6519
6520                continue;
6521            }
6522
6523            unset($this->resurrectQueue[$key]);
6524        }
6525    }

6527    /**
6528     * Session / Memory 服务 IPC 断开：广播降级 → 排队复活（最多 N 次），失败再整组重启。
6529     */
6530    private function handleInfraServiceIpcDisconnect(ServiceInstance $instance): void
6531    {
6532        if ($this->context === null) {
6533            return;
6534        }
6535
6536        if ($this->preserveExternallyManagedSharedInstance($instance, 'ipc_disconnect')) {
6537            return;
6538        }
6539
6540        $this->infraDegraded[$instance->role] = true;
6541        WlsLogger::warning_(
6542            "[Orchestrator] {$instance->role}#{$instance->instanceId} IPC 断开：向 Worker 广播 ROUTING_POLICY（端点降级），随后复活（最多 {$this->infraServiceResurrectAttempts} 次）"
6543        );
6544        $this->broadcastRoutingPolicyToWorkers();
6545
6546        $key = $instance->getKey();
6547        $pid = $instance->pid;
6548        $processStillRunning = $pid > 0 && $this->isProcessRunning($pid);
6549        $delay = $processStillRunning ? \max(2.0, $this->ipcReconnectGraceSec) : 0.0;
6550        $port = (int) ($instance->port ?? 0);
6551
6552        if (isset($this->resurrectQueue[$key])) {
6553            $this->resurrectQueue[$key]['infraRetryBudget'] = $this->infraServiceResurrectAttempts;
6554            if (($this->resurrectQueue[$key]['scheduledAt'] ?? 0.0) > \microtime(true) + $delay) {
6555                $this->resurrectQueue[$key]['scheduledAt'] = \microtime(true) + $delay;
6556            }
6557            WlsLogger::info_("[Orchestrator] {$key} 已在复活队列，刷新重试预算与调度时间");
6558
6559            return;
6560        }
6561
6562        $instance->state = ServiceInstance::STATE_FAILED;
6563        $instance->restarts++;
6564        $this->registry->updateInstance($instance);
6565
6566        $this->resurrectQueue[$key] = [
6567            'role' => $instance->role,
6568            'instanceId' => $instance->instanceId,
6569            'maxRestarts' => 10,
6570            'restartDelay' => $delay,
6571            'scheduledAt' => \microtime(true) + $delay,
6572            'delayed' => $processStillRunning,
6573            'pid' => $pid,
6574            'port' => $port,
6575            'infraRetryBudget' => $this->infraServiceResurrectAttempts,
6576        ];
6577    }
6578
6579    /**
6580     * 强制终止进程（委托给进程管理类）
6581     *
6582     * 遵循 SOLID 原则：进程管理职责由 Processer 类承担。
6583     */
6584    private function forceKillProcess(int $pid): bool
6585    {
6586        if ($pid <= 0) {
6587            return false;
6588        }
6589        return Processer::killByPid($pid, true);
6590    }
6591
6592    /**
6593     * 复活前确保旧进程已经真正退出，优先按真实 PID 终止，避免 PID 文件滞后误杀失败。
6594     */
6595    private function terminateStaleProcessBeforeResurrection(?ServiceInstance $oldInstance, int $pid, int $port): bool
6596    {
6597        if ($pid <= 0) {
6598            return $this->ensurePortReleasedForResurrection($port);
6599        }
6600
6601        if (!$this->isProcessRunning($pid)) {
6602            return $this->ensurePortReleasedForResurrection($port);
6603        }
6604
6605        WlsLogger::warning_("[Orchestrator] 进程 {$pid} 仍在运行（IPC已断开），优先按真实 PID 终止");
6606
6607        $stopped = Processer::gracefulKill($pid, 1.0, true);
6608        if (!$stopped) {
6609            $stopped = Processer::killProcessTreeByPid($pid, true);
6610        }
6611        if (!$stopped && $oldInstance !== null) {
6612            $this->killInstanceProcess($oldInstance);
6613            $stopped = !$this->isProcessRunning($pid);
6614        }
6615
6616        if ($port > 0) {
6617            Processer::clearPortCache($port);
6618        }
6619
6620        return $stopped && !$this->isProcessRunning($pid) && $this->ensurePortReleasedForResurrection($port);
6621    }
6622
6623    /**
6624     * 复活前确认监听端口已释放，必要时再次清理己方残留占用。
6625     */
6626    private function ensurePortReleasedForResurrection(int $port): bool
6627    {
6628        if ($port <= 0) {
6629            return true;
6630        }
6631
6632        if ($this->waitForPortRelease($port, 1.5)) {
6633            return true;
6634        }
6635
6636        if (Processer::isPortUsedByWeline($port)) {
6637            WlsLogger::warning_("[Orchestrator] 端口 {$port} 仍被 Weline 进程占用，尝试按端口清理");
6638            Processer::killProcessByPort($port);
6639            Processer::forceReleasePort($port);
6640        }
6641
6642        return $this->waitForPortRelease($port, 1.5);
6643    }
6644
6645    /**
6646     * 等待端口释放，同时清理端口缓存，避免 Linux 侧短期缓存误判。
6647     */
6648    private function waitForPortRelease(int $port, float $timeout): bool
6649    {
6650        if ($port <= 0) {
6651            return true;
6652        }
6653
6654        $deadline = \microtime(true) + $timeout;
6655        do {
6656            if ($this->shouldYieldPeriodicWork(true)) {
6657                return false;
6658            }
6659            Processer::clearPortCache($port);
6660            if (!Processer::isPortInUse($port)) {
6661                return true;
6662            }
6663            if (!$this->sleepInterruptiblyForPeriodicWork(100000)) {
6664                return false;
6665            }
6666        } while (\microtime(true) < $deadline);
6667
6668        Processer::clearPortCache($port);
6669        return !Processer::isPortInUse($port);
6670    }

6753                return;
6754
6755            case ControlMessage::TYPE_TELEMETRY:
6756                $this->handleTelemetry($msg);
6757                return;
6758
6759            case ControlMessage::TYPE_STATUS_REPORT:
6760                $this->auditChildStatusReport($msg, $clientId);
6761                $this->delegateToProvider($msg, $clientId);
6762                return;
6763
6764            // 批量协调消息处理
6765            case ControlMessage::TYPE_BATCH_ACK:
6766                $this->handleBatchAck($msg, $clientId);
6767                return;
6768
6769            case ControlMessage::TYPE_BATCH_RESPONSE:
6770                $this->handleBatchResponse($msg, $clientId);
6771                return;
6772        }
6773
6774        // 非通用消息：委托给对应 Provider 处理
6775        $this->delegateToProvider($msg, $clientId);
6776    }
6777
6778    /**
6779     * 处理 register 消息
6780     *
6781     * 匹配策略（按优先级）：
6782     * 1. port 匹配（最可靠）
6783     * 2. instance_id/worker_id 匹配
6784     * 3. PID 匹配（Windows 下可能不准确，作为后备）
6785     * 4. 如果都不匹配但只有一个 STARTING 状态的实例，认为就是它
6786     */
6787    private function handleRegister(array $msg, int $clientId): void
6788    {
6789        $role              = $msg['role'] ?? '';
6790        $pid               = (int) ($msg['pid'] ?? 0);
6791        $port              = (int) ($msg['port'] ?? 0);
6792        $workerId          = (int) ($msg['worker_id'] ?? 0);
6793        $instanceIdFromMsg = (int) ($msg['instance_id'] ?? 0);
6794        $epoch             = (int) ($msg['epoch'] ?? 0);
6795        $launchId          = (string) ($msg['launch_id'] ?? '');
6796        $processKind       = (string) ($msg['process_kind'] ?? ControlMessage::PROCESS_KIND_FRAMEWORK);
6797        $moduleCode        = (string) ($msg['module_code'] ?? '');
6798
6799        // 代际校验：只接纳当前 epoch
6800        if ($this->context !== null && $epoch > 0 && $epoch !== $this->context->epoch) {
6801            WlsLogger::warning_("[Orchestrator] 丢弃旧代际 register: role={$role}, epoch={$epoch}, current_epoch={$this->context->epoch}");
6802            return;
6803        }
6804
6805        // 查找匹配的实例
6806        $instances = $this->registry->getInstancesByRole($role);
6807
6808        // 策略0：launch_id 精确匹配（最稳妥）
6809        if ($launchId !== '') {
6810            foreach ($instances as $instance) {
6811                if ($instance->launchId === $launchId) {
6812                    if ($this->registerInstanceIpc($instance, $clientId, $pid, $workerId, $epoch, $launchId, $processKind, $moduleCode)) {
6813                        return;
6814                    }
6815                }
6816            }
6817        }
6818
6819        // 策略1：port 匹配（最可靠）
6820        if ($port > 0) {
6821            foreach ($instances as $instance) {
6822                if ($instance->port === $port) {
6823                    if ($this->registerInstanceIpc($instance, $clientId, $pid, $workerId, $epoch, $launchId, $processKind, $moduleCode)) {
6824                        return;
6825                    }
6826                }
6827            }
6828        }
6829
6830        // 策略2：instance_id/worker_id 匹配
6831        if ($instanceIdFromMsg > 0 || $workerId > 0) {
6832            $targetId = $instanceIdFromMsg > 0 ? $instanceIdFromMsg : $workerId;
6833            foreach ($instances as $instance) {
6834                if ($instance->instanceId === $targetId) {
6835                    if ($this->registerInstanceIpc($instance, $clientId, $pid, $workerId, $epoch, $launchId, $processKind, $moduleCode)) {
6836                        return;
6837                    }
6838                }
6839            }
6840        }
6841
6842        // 策略3：PID 匹配（Windows 下可能不准确）
6843        if ($pid > 0) {
6844            foreach ($instances as $instance) {
6845                if ($instance->pid === $pid) {
6846                    if ($this->registerInstanceIpc($instance, $clientId, $pid, $workerId, $epoch, $launchId, $processKind, $moduleCode)) {
6847                        return;
6848                    }
6849                }
6850            }
6851        }
6852
6853        // 策略4：如果只有一个 STARTING 状态的同角色实例，认为就是它
6854        $startingInstances = \array_filter($instances, fn($i) => $i->state === ServiceInstance::STATE_STARTING && $i->ipcClientId === null);
6855        if (\count($startingInstances) === 1) {
6856            $instance = \reset($startingInstances);
6857            WlsLogger::info_("[Orchestrator] 匹配到唯一 STARTING 实例: {$role}#{$instance->instanceId}");
6858            if ($this->registerInstanceIpc($instance, $clientId, $pid, $workerId, $epoch, $launchId, $processKind, $moduleCode)) {
6859                return;
6860            }
6861        }
6862
6863        WlsLogger::warning_("[Orchestrator] 未找到匹配的实例: role={$role}, pid={$pid}, port={$port}, workerId={$workerId}, epoch={$epoch}, launch_id={$launchId}");
6864        if ($pid > 0 && $this->shouldTerminateUnmatchedRegisterPid($role)) {
6865            $killed = Processer::killByPid($pid);
6866            if ($killed) {
6867                WlsLogger::warning_("[Orchestrator] 已终止未匹配 register 进程: role={$role}, pid={$pid}");
6868            }
6869        }
6870        $this->controlServer?->closeClient($clientId);
6871    }
6872
6873    private function shouldTerminateUnmatchedRegisterPid(string $role): bool
6874    {
6875        if (!\in_array(
6876            $role,
6877            [
6878                ControlMessage::ROLE_WORKER,
6879                ControlMessage::ROLE_MAINTENANCE,
6880                ControlMessage::ROLE_DISPATCHER,
6881                ControlMessage::ROLE_REDIRECT,
6882            ],
6883            true
6884        )) {
6885            return false;
6886        }
6887
6888        return (bool) ($this->context?->getConfig(
6889            'wls.orchestrator.kill_unmatched_register_processes',
6890            true
6891        ) ?? true);
6892    }
6893
6894    /**
6895     * 注册实例的 IPC 连接
6896     */
6897    private function registerInstanceIpc(
6898        ServiceInstance $instance,
6899        int $clientId,
6900        int $pid,
6901        int $workerId,
6902        int $epoch = 0,
6903        string $launchId = '',
6904        string $processKind = ControlMessage::PROCESS_KIND_FRAMEWORK,
6905        string $moduleCode = ''
6906    ): bool
6907    {
6908        if ($this->context !== null && $epoch > 0 && $epoch !== $this->context->epoch) {
6909            WlsLogger::warning_("[Orchestrator] 忽略旧代际实例注册 {$instance->role}#{$instance->instanceId}: epoch={$epoch}");
6910            return false;
6911        }
6912        if ($launchId !== '' && $instance->launchId !== '' && $instance->launchId !== $launchId) {
6913            WlsLogger::warning_("[Orchestrator] 忽略 launchId 不匹配注册 {$instance->role}#{$instance->instanceId}: msg={$launchId}, expected={$instance->launchId}");
6914            return false;
6915        }
6916
6917        $instance->ipcClientId = $clientId;
6918        $instance->state = ServiceInstance::STATE_REGISTERED;
6919        if ($epoch > 0) {
6920            $instance->epoch = $epoch;
6921        }
6922        if ($launchId !== '') {
6923            $instance->launchId = $launchId;
6924        }
6925        // 记录进程归属类型和模块代码
6926        if ($processKind !== ControlMessage::PROCESS_KIND_FRAMEWORK) {
6927            $instance->processKind = $processKind;
6928        }
6929        if ($moduleCode !== '') {
6930            $instance->moduleCode = $moduleCode;
6931        }
6932        // 更新真实 PID（Windows 下 spawnProcess 返回的可能不准确）
6933        if ($pid > 0 && $instance->pid !== $pid) {
6934            WlsLogger::debug_("[Orchestrator] 更新 PID: {$instance->role}#{$instance->instanceId} 从 {$instance->pid} 到 {$pid}");
6935            $instance->pid = $pid;
6936        }
6937        $registerReceivedAt = \microtime(true);
6938        $instance->setMeta('register_received_at', $registerReceivedAt);
6939        if ($instance->startedAt > 0) {
6940            $instance->setMeta(
6941                'register_elapsed_ms',
6942                \max(0, (int) \round(($registerReceivedAt - $instance->startedAt) * 1000))
6943            );
6944        }
6945        if ($workerId > 0) {
6946            $instance->setMeta('worker_id', $workerId);
6947        }
6948        $this->registry->updateInstance($instance);
6949        if ($this->context !== null) {
6950            $this->persistServicesInfo($this->context);
6951        }
6952
6953        $resurrectKey = $instance->getKey();
6954        if (isset($this->resurrectQueue[$resurrectKey])) {
6955            unset($this->resurrectQueue[$resurrectKey]);
6956            WlsLogger::info_("[Orchestrator] {$instance->role}#{$instance->instanceId} 已重新注册，取消待执行复活");
6957        }
6958
6959        if (\in_array($instance->role, [ControlMessage::ROLE_WORKER, ControlMessage::ROLE_MAINTENANCE], true)) {
6960            $this->sendRoutingPolicyToWorker($instance);
6961        }
6962
6963        $this->logStartupTiming($instance, 'registered', [
6964            'client_id' => $clientId,
6965            'worker_id' => $workerId > 0 ? $workerId : null,
6966            'register_elapsed_ms' => $instance->getMeta('register_elapsed_ms'),
6967            'process_kind' => $processKind !== ControlMessage::PROCESS_KIND_FRAMEWORK ? $processKind : null,
6968            'module_code' => $moduleCode !== '' ? $moduleCode : null,
6969        ]);
6970
6971        $kindInfo = $processKind !== ControlMessage::PROCESS_KIND_FRAMEWORK
6972            ? ", kind={$processKind}" . ($moduleCode !== '' ? "({$moduleCode})" : '')
6973            : '';
6974        WlsLogger::debug_("[Orchestrator] IPC 注册: {$instance->role}#{$instance->instanceId} (pid={$pid}, clientId={$clientId}, port={$instance->port}, epoch={$instance->epoch}, launch_id={$instance->launchId}{$kindInfo})");
6975        return true;
6976    }

6978    /**
6979     * 处理 ready 消息
6980     */
6981    private function handleReady(array $msg, int $clientId): void
6982    {
6983        $instance = $this->registry->getInstanceByIpcClient($clientId);
6984        if ($instance === null) {
6985            // 某些平台/高压场景下可能出现 register 丢失但 ready 到达，先尝试补绑再处理。
6986            $this->handleRegister($msg, $clientId);
6987            $instance = $this->registry->getInstanceByIpcClient($clientId);
6988            if ($instance === null) {
6989                $role = (string)($msg['role'] ?? '');
6990                $port = (int)($msg['port'] ?? 0);
6991                WlsLogger::warning_("[Orchestrator] ready 消息但未找到实例: clientId={$clientId}, role={$role}, port={$port}");
6992                $this->controlServer?->closeClient($clientId);
6993                return;
6994            }
6995        }
6996
6997        $epoch = (int) ($msg['epoch'] ?? 0);
6998        $launchId = (string) ($msg['launch_id'] ?? '');
6999        if ($this->context !== null && $epoch > 0 && $epoch !== $this->context->epoch) {
7000            WlsLogger::warning_("[Orchestrator] 丢弃旧代际 ready: {$instance->role}#{$instance->instanceId}, epoch={$epoch}");
7001            return;
7002        }
7003        if ($launchId !== '' && $instance->launchId !== '' && $launchId !== $instance->launchId) {
7004            WlsLogger::warning_("[Orchestrator] 丢弃 launchId 不匹配 ready: {$instance->role}#{$instance->instanceId}, msg={$launchId}, expected={$instance->launchId}");
7005            return;
7006        }
7007
7008        // 更新实例端口（以上报的实际端口为准）
7009        $reportedPort = (int) ($msg['port'] ?? 0);
7010        if ($reportedPort > 0 && $reportedPort !== $instance->port) {
7011            WlsLogger::debug_("[Orchestrator] 更新 {$instance->role}#{$instance->instanceId} 端口: {$instance->port} -> {$reportedPort}");
7012            $instance->port = $reportedPort;
7013        }
7014
7015        $isDuplicateReadyFromSameClient = $instance->state === ServiceInstance::STATE_READY
7016            && $instance->ipcClientId === $clientId;
7017        $readyAlreadyRecorded = $instance->getMeta('ready_at') !== null;
7018        if ($isDuplicateReadyFromSameClient && $readyAlreadyRecorded) {
7019            $workerId = (int) ($instance->getMeta('worker_id') ?? $instance->instanceId);
7020            $this->controlServer?->sendTo($clientId, ControlMessage::ackReady($workerId));
7021            WlsLogger::info_(
7022                "[Orchestrator] 重复 READY 已幂等处理: {$instance->role}#{$instance->instanceId} (clientId={$clientId}, port={$instance->port})"
7023            );
7024            if ($this->context !== null) {
7025                $this->persistServicesInfo($this->context);
7026            }
7027            return;
7028        }
7029
7030        $instance->state = ServiceInstance::STATE_READY;
7031        $readyReceivedAt = \microtime(true);
7032        $instance->setMeta('ready_at', $readyReceivedAt);
7033        $instance->setMeta('ready_received_at', $readyReceivedAt);
7034        if ($instance->startedAt > 0) {
7035            $instance->setMeta(
7036                'ready_elapsed_ms',
7037                \max(0, (int) \round(($readyReceivedAt - $instance->startedAt) * 1000))
7038            );
7039        }
7040        $this->registry->updateInstance($instance);
7041
7042        // 发送 ACK_READY 确认
7043        $workerId = (int) ($instance->getMeta('worker_id') ?? $instance->instanceId);
7044        $this->controlServer?->sendTo($clientId, ControlMessage::ackReady($workerId));
7045        $ackReadyAt = \microtime(true);
7046        $instance->setMeta('ack_ready_at', $ackReadyAt);
7047        if ($instance->startedAt > 0) {
7048            $instance->setMeta(
7049                'ack_ready_elapsed_ms',
7050                \max(0, (int) \round(($ackReadyAt - $instance->startedAt) * 1000))
7051            );
7052        }
7053        $this->registry->updateInstance($instance);
7054
7055        WlsLogger::info_("[Orchestrator] 服务就绪: {$instance->role}#{$instance->instanceId} (已发送 ACK, port={$instance->port})");
7056
7057        // 如果是 Worker 就绪，通知 Dispatcher 添加该端口
7058        if ($instance->role === 'worker' && $instance->port !== null) {
7059            $maintenanceModeBeforeReady = $this->maintenanceMode;
7060            // 检查是否应该退出维护模式（业务 Worker 已就绪）
7061            $this->checkAndDisableMaintenanceIfReady();
7062            // 维护模式仍在生效时，业务 Worker 只做待命，不应提前被 Dispatcher 纳入流量池。
7063            if (!$maintenanceModeBeforeReady) {
7064                $this->notifyDispatcherWorkerReady($instance);
7065            }
7066        }
7067
7068        // 维护 Worker 就绪：必须在维护模式下推送 SET_WORKER_POOL。否则 Dispatcher 若早于维护进程 READY，
7069        // sendAllWorkerPortsToDispatcher 会因「尚无 READY maintenance」跳过下发，池永久为空直至其它路径补偿。
7070        $this->logStartupTiming($instance, 'ready', [
7071            'client_id' => $clientId,
7072            'worker_id' => $workerId,
7073            'ready_elapsed_ms' => $instance->getMeta('ready_elapsed_ms'),
7074            'ack_ready_elapsed_ms' => $instance->getMeta('ack_ready_elapsed_ms'),
7075        ]);
7076
7077        if ($instance->role === ControlMessage::ROLE_MAINTENANCE
7078            && $this->maintenanceMode
7079            && $instance->port !== null
7080            && $instance->port > 0) {
7081            $this->pushMaintenanceWorkerPoolToDispatchersFromRegistry();
7082        }
7083
7084        // 如果是 Dispatcher 就绪，发送所有已就绪的 Worker 端口列表和 HTTP Redirect 端口
7085        if ($instance->role === 'dispatcher') {
7086            $this->sendAllWorkerPortsToDispatcher($instance);
7087            $this->sendRedirectPortToDispatcher($instance);
7088        }
7089        
7090        // 如果是 Redirect 就绪，通知所有已就绪的 Dispatcher
7091        if ($instance->role === 'redirect' && $instance->port !== null) {
7092            $this->notifyDispatcherRedirectReady($instance);
7093        }
7094
7095        if (($this->infraDegraded[$instance->role] ?? false) === true) {
7096            $this->infraDegraded[$instance->role] = false;
7097            WlsLogger::info_("[Orchestrator] {$instance->role} 已 READY，解除端点降级并广播 ROUTING_POLICY");
7098            $this->broadcastRoutingPolicyToWorkers();
7099        }
7100        
7101        // 更新实例文件中的服务信息
7102        if ($this->context !== null) {
7103            $this->persistServicesInfo($this->context);
7104        }
7105        
7106        // 检查是否所有服务都已就绪，输出服务器准备就绪通知
7107        $this->checkAndNotifyServerReady();
7108    }
7109
7110    /**
7111     * 检查所有服务是否就绪，如果是则输出服务器准备就绪通知
7112     */
7113    private function checkAndNotifyServerReady(): void
7114    {
7115        if (!$this->serverReadyNotificationArmed || $this->serverReadyNotified) {
7116            return;
7117        }
7118
7119        $allInstances = $this->registry->getAllInstances();
7120        if (empty($allInstances)) {
7121            return;
7122        }
7123
7124        // 检查所有实例是否都已就绪
7125        foreach ($allInstances as $instance) {
7126            if ($instance->state !== ServiceInstance::STATE_READY) {
7127                return;
7128            }
7129        }
7130
7131        // 所有服务都已就绪
7132        $this->serverReadyNotified = true;
7133
7134        $totalServices = \count($allInstances);
7135        if ($this->context !== null) {
7136            $this->markStartupPhaseRunning($this->context, $totalServices);
7137        }
7138        $mainPort = $this->context?->mainPort ?? 0;
7139        $bindHost = $this->context?->host ?? '127.0.0.1';
7140        $displayHost = $this->context?->publicHost ?? $bindHost;
7141        $sslEnabled = $this->context?->sslEnabled ?? false;
7142        $protocol = $sslEnabled ? 'https' : 'http';
7143
7144        // 输出醒目的服务器准备就绪通知
7145        WlsLogger::info_('[Server] ========================================');
7146        WlsLogger::info_('[Server] ✓ 服务器准备就绪');
7147        WlsLogger::info_("[Server]   地址: {$protocol}://{$displayHost}:{$mainPort}");
7148        WlsLogger::info_("[Server]   服务实例: {$totalServices} 个");
7149        WlsLogger::info_('[Server] ========================================');
7150
7151        // 前台模式：直接输出访问地址表与代理转发说明（不悬浮，日志正常滚动）
7152        if ($this->context?->frontend) {
7153            $ctx = $this->context;

7648                );
7649            }
7650        }

7655                . '，' . $this->formatMaintenanceOperationContext(),

7663    /**
7664     * 用 Registry 中当前所有 READY Worker 端口重写 Dispatcher 负载池并广播路由策略。
7665     *
7666     * 多 Worker 滚动/热重载（se:rel、server:maintenance rolling）在 maintenanceMode=false 时
7667     * 仅靠 REMOVE_WORKER + ADD_WORKER 逐条更新；若 IPC 偶发丢包或顺序与 Dispatcher 内部状态漂移，
7668     * 会出现「Master 侧 Worker 已 READY 但入口仍难访问」。结束后以 SET_WORKER_POOL 全量对齐可恢复。
7669     */
7670    private function syncDispatcherFullWorkerPoolFromRegistry(): void
7671    {
7672        if ($this->registry->getInstancesByRole('dispatcher') === [] || $this->controlServer === null) {
7673            $this->lastDispatcherWorkerPoolSignature = '';
7674            return;
7675        }
7676
7677        $ports = [];
7678        foreach ($this->registry->getInstancesByRole('worker') as $w) {
7679            if ($w->state === ServiceInstance::STATE_READY && $w->port !== null && $w->port > 0) {
7680                $ports[] = (int) $w->port;
7681            }
7682        }
7683
7684        if ($ports === []) {
7685            if ($this->serverReadyNotified) {
7686                WlsLogger::warning_('[Orchestrator] syncDispatcherFullWorkerPoolFromRegistry: 无 READY Worker，跳过 SET_WORKER_POOL');
7687            }
7688            $this->lastDispatcherWorkerPoolSignature = '';
7689
7690            return;
7691        }
7692
7693        \sort($ports, SORT_NUMERIC);
7694        $signature = \implode(',', $ports);
7695        if ($signature === $this->lastDispatcherWorkerPoolSignature) {
7696            return;
7697        }
7698
7699        $this->notifyDispatcherSetWorkerPool($ports);
7700        $this->controlServer->poll(0, 150000);
7701        $this->broadcastRoutingPolicyToWorkers();
7702        $this->lastDispatcherWorkerPoolSignature = $signature;
7703        WlsLogger::info_('[Orchestrator] Dispatcher 全量 Worker 池已对齐 Registry: ' . $signature);
7704    }

7813    /**
7814     * 处理 command 消息
7815     */
7816    private function handleCommand(array $msg, int $clientId): void
7817    {
7818        $action = $msg['action'] ?? '';
7819        if (!\is_string($action) || $action === '') {
7820            $this->controlServer?->sendTo($clientId, ControlMessage::commandResult(false, [], 'Unknown command'));
7821
7822            return;
7823        }
7824
7825        if ($this->isQueuedControlCommand($action)) {
7826            if ($action === ControlMessage::ACTION_STOP) {
7827                $stopIntent = (string)($msg['stop_intent'] ?? '');
7828                $stopSource = (string)($msg['stop_source'] ?? 'unknown');
7829                $stopTraceId = (string)($msg['stop_trace_id'] ?? '');
7830                if ($stopIntent !== 'explicit') {
7831                    WlsLogger::warning_(
7832                        "[Orchestrator] 拒绝未显式确认的 STOP 命令: client={$clientId}, action={$action}, source={$stopSource}, trace={$stopTraceId}"
7833                    );
7834                    $this->controlServer?->sendTo(
7835                        $clientId,
7836                        ControlMessage::commandResult(false, [], 'STOP rejected: missing explicit stop intent')
7837                    );
7838
7839                    return;
7840                }
7841
7842                WlsLogger::warning_(
7843                    "[Orchestrator] 接收 STOP 命令: client={$clientId}, source={$stopSource}, trace={$stopTraceId}"
7844                );
7845                $this->clearPendingControlOperations('Control operation cancelled by stop');
7846                $this->preemptActiveControlOperationForStop();
7847                $this->requestStop('command', $clientId, true);
7848
7849                return;
7850            }
7851
7852            if ($this->isMaintenanceControlAction($action)) {
7853                if ($this->isMaintenanceActionAlreadySatisfied($action)) {
7854                    $message = $action === ControlMessage::ACTION_MAINTENANCE_ENABLE
7855                        ? 'Maintenance already enabled'
7856                        : 'Maintenance already disabled';
7857                    $this->controlServer?->sendTo(
7858                        $clientId,
7859                        ControlMessage::commandResult(true, [
7860                            'async' => false,
7861                            'accepted' => true,
7862                            'operation_id' => null,
7863                            'state' => self::CONTROL_OPERATION_STATE_COMPLETED,
7864                        ], $message)
7865                    );
7866                    return;
7867                }
7868
7869                $oppositeAction = $this->getOppositeMaintenanceAction($action);
7870                if ($oppositeAction !== null) {
7871                    $removed = $this->dropQueuedControlOperationsByAction(
7872                        $oppositeAction,
7873                        "Superseded by {$action}"
7874                    );
7875                    if ($removed > 0) {
7876                        WlsLogger::info_(
7877                            "[Orchestrator] 维护指令队列收敛：移除 {$removed} 个 {$oppositeAction}，incoming={$action}, client={$clientId}"
7878                        );
7879                    }
7880                }
7881            }
7882
7883            if ($this->isDeduplicableQueuedControlCommand($action)) {
7884                $existingOperation = $this->findEquivalentQueuedOrActiveOperation($action);
7885                if ($existingOperation !== null) {
7886                    WlsLogger::info_(
7887                        "[Orchestrator] 控制操作去重 action={$action} client={$clientId} -> existing={$existingOperation['id']}"
7888                    );
7889                    $this->sendDeduplicatedControlOperationAck($clientId, [
7890                        'id' => (string)$existingOperation['id'],
7891                        'action' => (string)$existingOperation['action'],
7892                        'state' => (string)$existingOperation['state'],
7893                    ]);
7894
7895                    return;
7896                }
7897            }
7898
7899            $operation = $this->queueControlOperation($action, $msg, $clientId);
7900            $this->sendQueuedControlOperationAck($operation);
7901
7902            return;
7903        }
7904
7905        switch ($action) {
7906            case ControlMessage::ACTION_STATUS:
7907                $status = $this->getStatus();
7908                $this->controlServer?->sendTo($clientId, ControlMessage::commandResult(true, $status, 'Status retrieved'));
7909                break;
7910
7911            case ControlMessage::ACTION_TELEMETRY_QUERY:
7912                $instance = (string)($msg['instance'] ?? ($this->context?->instanceName ?? 'default'));
7913                $windowSec = (int)($msg['window_sec'] ?? 300);
7914                $host = (string)($msg['host'] ?? '');
7915                $sinceTs = \time() - \max(60, $windowSec);
7916                $aggregator = $this->getMetricsAggregator();
7917                $aggregator->flushDueBuckets(false);
7918                $data = [
7919                    'global' => $aggregator->snapshotGlobal($instance, $sinceTs),
7920                    'hosts' => $aggregator->snapshotByHost($instance, $sinceTs),
7921                    'host_detail' => $host !== '' ? $aggregator->snapshotHostDetail($instance, $host, $sinceTs) : null,
7922                ];
7923                $this->controlServer?->sendTo($clientId, ControlMessage::commandResult(true, $data, 'Telemetry retrieved'));
7924                break;
7925
7926            case ControlMessage::ACTION_FIBER_STATS:
7927                $this->requestFiberPoolStats($clientId);
7928                break;
7929
7930            default:
7931                $this->controlServer?->sendTo($clientId, ControlMessage::commandResult(false, [], 'Unknown command'));
7932                break;
7933        }
7934    }

7936    /** Fiber 统计请求超时（秒），超时后返回已收集的 partial 结果 */

7939    /**

7945    {

7948                yield $instance;

7950        }

7953    /**

7955     */
7956    private function requestFiberPoolStats(int $replyClientId): void
7957    {
7958        if ($this->pendingFiberStatsRequest !== null) {
7959            $this->controlServer?->sendTo($replyClientId, ControlMessage::commandResult(
7960                false,
7961                [],
7962                (string)__('已有 Fiber 统计请求进行中，请稍后再试')
7963            ));
7964            return;
7965        }
7966        $waiting = [];
7967        $requestId = 'fiber_stats_' . \uniqid('', true);
7968        foreach ($this->getFiberEligibleInstances() as $instance) {
7969            if ($instance->ipcClientId !== null && $this->controlServer !== null) {
7970                $this->controlServer->sendTo($instance->ipcClientId, ControlMessage::fiberPoolQuery($requestId));
7971                $waiting[$instance->ipcClientId] = true;
7972            }
7973        }
7974        if ($waiting === []) {
7975            $this->controlServer?->sendTo($replyClientId, ControlMessage::commandResult(true, ['workers' => [], 'total_suspended' => 0], __('无已连接 Worker')));
7976            return;
7977        }
7978        $this->pendingFiberStatsRequest = [
7979            'replyClientId' => $replyClientId,
7980            'request_id' => $requestId,
7981            'waiting' => $waiting,
7982            'replies' => [],
7983            'created_at' => \time(),
7984        ];
7985    }

7987    /**
7988     * 处理 Worker 上报的 Fiber 池统计，聚合完成后回传 CLI
7989     */
7990    private function handleFiberPoolStatsReply(array $msg, int $clientId): void
7991    {
7992        if ($this->pendingFiberStatsRequest === null) {
7993            return;
7994        }
7995        $req = &$this->pendingFiberStatsRequest;
7996        if (($msg['request_id'] ?? '') !== $req['request_id']) {
7997            return;
7998        }
7999        unset($req['waiting'][$clientId]);
8000        $req['replies'][$clientId] = [
8001            'worker_id' => $msg['worker_id'] ?? 0,
8002            'suspended' => $msg['suspended'] ?? 0,
8003            'idle_ttl_sec' => $msg['idle_ttl_sec'] ?? 0,
8004            'max_active' => $msg['max_active'] ?? 0,
8005            'released_count' => $msg['released_count'] ?? 0,
8006        ];
8007        if ($req['waiting'] !== []) {
8008            return;
8009        }
8010        $replyClientId = $req['replyClientId'];
8011        $workers = \array_values($req['replies']);
8012        $this->pendingFiberStatsRequest = null;
8013        $totalSuspended = \array_sum(\array_column($workers, 'suspended'));
8014        $data = ['workers' => $workers, 'total_suspended' => $totalSuspended];
8015        $this->controlServer?->sendTo($replyClientId, ControlMessage::commandResult(true, $data, __('已聚合 %{1} 个 Worker 的 Fiber 池统计', [\count($workers)])));
8016    }

8018    /**
8019     * 若存在超时的 Fiber 统计请求，则返回已收集的 partial 结果（主循环中调用，避免无消息时永久挂起）
8020     */
8021    private function completePendingFiberStatsIfTimeout(): void
8022    {

8040    private function handleTelemetry(array $msg): void
8041    {
8042        $host = (string) ($msg['host'] ?? '');
8043        $status = (int) ($msg['status'] ?? 200);
8044        $latencyMs = (int) ($msg['latency_ms'] ?? 0);
8045        $bytesOut = (int) ($msg['bytes_out'] ?? 0);
8046        $instance = (string) ($msg['instance'] ?? ($this->context?->instanceName ?? 'default'));
8047
8048        if ($status >= 500) {
8049            $this->recoverSlotsAfterTelemetryHttpFailure($instance);
8050        } elseif ($status < 100 || $status > 599) {
8051            $this->logTelemetryAnomalyThrottled(
8052                "bad_status_{$status}_{$host}",
8053                "[Master自检] 遥测 status 非法: {$status} host={$host} instance={$instance}"
8054            );
8055        }
8056        if ($latencyMs < 0 || $latencyMs > 600_000) {
8057            $this->logTelemetryAnomalyThrottled(
8058                "lat_{$host}",
8059                "[Master自检] 遥测延迟异常 latency_ms={$latencyMs} host={$host} instance={$instance}"
8060            );
8061        }
8062        if ($bytesOut < 0 || $bytesOut > 512 * 1024 * 1024) {
8063            $this->logTelemetryAnomalyThrottled(
8064                "bytes_{$host}",
8065                "[Master自检] 遥测 bytes_out 异常: {$bytesOut} host={$host} instance={$instance}"
8066            );
8067        }
8068
8069        $this->getTelemetryGateway()->record([
8070            'instance' => $instance,
8071            'host' => $host,
8072            'status' => $status,
8073            'latency_ms' => $latencyMs,
8074            'bytes_out' => $bytesOut,
8075            'ts' => (int) ($msg['ts'] ?? \time()),
8076        ]);
8077    }

8079    private function logTelemetryAnomalyThrottled(string $key, string $message): void
8080    {
8081        $now = \microtime(true);
8082        $last = (float) ($this->telemetryAnomalyLoggedAt[$key] ?? 0.0);
8083        if ($now - $last < 15.0) {
8084            return;
8085        }
8086        $this->telemetryAnomalyLoggedAt[$key] = $now;
8087        if (\count($this->telemetryAnomalyLoggedAt) > 300) {
8088            $this->telemetryAnomalyLoggedAt = \array_slice($this->telemetryAnomalyLoggedAt, -150, 150, true);
8089        }
8090        WlsLogger::error_($message);
8091    }

8093    /**
8094     * 遥测 HTTP>=500 只作为 Worker 存活槽位补齐信号，不把业务 5xx 直接判成 Master 自检异常。
8095     *
8096     * @return array{
8097     *     eligible: bool,
8098     *     desired: int,
8099     *     alive: int,
8100     *     slots_healthy: bool,
8101     *     recovery_dispatched: bool,
8102     *     reason: string
8103     * }
8104     */
8105    private function recoverSlotsAfterTelemetryHttpFailure(string $instance): array
8106    {
8107        $decision = $this->inspectTelemetryHttpFailureWorkerSlots($instance);
8108        if (!$decision['eligible'] || $decision['slots_healthy']) {
8109            return $decision;
8110        }
8111        $interval = (float) ($this->context->getConfig('wls.orchestrator.telemetry_5xx_worker_recovery_cooldown_sec', 3.0) ?? 3.0);
8112        if ($interval < 1.0) {
8113            $interval = 1.0;
8114        }
8115        $now = \microtime(true);
8116        $last = (float) ($this->telemetryWorkerRecoveryAt[$instance] ?? 0.0);
8117        if ($now - $last < $interval) {
8118            $decision['reason'] = 'worker_slots_missing_cooldown';
8119
8120            return $decision;
8121        }
8122        $this->telemetryWorkerRecoveryAt[$instance] = $now;
8123        if (\count($this->telemetryWorkerRecoveryAt) > 64) {
8124            $this->telemetryWorkerRecoveryAt = \array_slice($this->telemetryWorkerRecoveryAt, -32, 32, true);
8125        }
8126        WlsLogger::warning_(
8127            "[Master自检] 遥测 HTTP≥500 且 Worker 存活槽位不足（存活 {$decision['alive']}/期望 {$decision['desired']}）— 立即补齐拉起"
8128        );
8129        $this->reconcileRoleSlotGaps('worker');
8130
8131        $decision['recovery_dispatched'] = true;
8132        $decision['reason'] = 'worker_slots_missing_recovery';
8133
8134        return $decision;
8135    }
8136
8137    /**
8138     * @return array{
8139     *     eligible: bool,
8140     *     desired: int,
8141     *     alive: int,
8142     *     slots_healthy: bool,
8143     *     recovery_dispatched: bool,
8144     *     reason: string
8145     * }
8146     */
8147    private function inspectTelemetryHttpFailureWorkerSlots(string $instance): array
8148    {
8149        $decision = [
8150            'eligible' => false,
8151            'desired' => 0,
8152            'alive' => 0,
8153            'slots_healthy' => false,
8154            'recovery_dispatched' => false,
8155            'reason' => 'orchestrator_inactive',
8156        ];
8157
8158        if ($this->context === null || !$this->running || $this->shuttingDown || $this->masterShutdownIntent) {
8159            return $decision;
8160        }
8161        if ($this->childServicesBootstrapInProgress) {
8162            $decision['reason'] = 'child_services_bootstrap';
8163
8164            return $decision;
8165        }
8166        if ($this->startAllCompletedAt > 0.0 && (\microtime(true) - $this->startAllCompletedAt) < 50.0) {
8167            $decision['reason'] = 'startup_cooldown';
8168
8169            return $decision;
8170        }
8171        $desired = (int) ($this->desiredState['worker'] ?? 0);
8172        $decision['desired'] = $desired;
8173        if ($desired <= 0) {
8174            $decision['reason'] = 'worker_not_expected';
8175
8176            return $decision;
8177        }
8178
8179        $alive = $this->countRoleSlotsProcessAlive('worker');
8180        $decision['eligible'] = true;
8181        $decision['alive'] = $alive;
8182        $decision['slots_healthy'] = $alive >= $desired;
8183        $decision['reason'] = $decision['slots_healthy']
8184            ? 'worker_slots_healthy'
8185            : 'worker_slots_missing';
8186
8187        return $decision;
8188    }

8211    /**
8212     * Master 自检：控制面、各角色槽位 READY 数、缺则补齐（Worker / Dispatcher 等）
8213     */
8214    private function performMasterSelfAudit(): void
8215    {
8216        if ($this->context === null || !$this->running || $this->shuttingDown) {
8217            return;
8218        }
8219        if ($this->masterShutdownIntent) {
8220            return;
8221        }
8222        if ($this->childServicesBootstrapInProgress) {
8223            return;
8224        }
8225
8226        $port = $this->controlServer?->getPort() ?? 0;
8227        if ($this->controlServer === null || $port <= 0) {
8228            WlsLogger::error_('[Master自检] Master 控制面 IPC 不可用');
8229
8230            return;
8231        }
8232
8233        if ($this->startAllCompletedAt > 0.0 && (\microtime(true) - $this->startAllCompletedAt) < 50.0) {
8234            return;
8235        }
8236
8237        foreach (['worker', 'dispatcher', 'redirect', 'session_server'] as $role) {
8238            if ($this->shouldYieldPeriodicWork(true)) {
8239                return;
8240            }
8241            $desired = (int) ($this->desiredState[$role] ?? 0);
8242            if ($desired <= 0) {
8243                continue;
8244            }
8245            $ready = $this->countRoleSlotsReadyHealthy($role);
8246            if ($ready >= $desired) {
8247                continue;
8248            }
8249            if ($role === 'worker') {
8250                WlsLogger::error_(
8251                    "[Master自检] Worker 未完备: 期望 {$desired} 槽位 READY，当前 {$ready}，执行补齐"
8252                );
8253            } elseif ($role === 'dispatcher') {
8254                WlsLogger::error_(
8255                    "[Master自检] Dispatcher 异常或缺失: 期望 {$desired}，就绪 {$ready} — 尝试维护/拉起"
8256                );
8257            } else {
8258                WlsLogger::warning_(
8259                    "[Master自检] {$role} 槽位不齐: 期望 {$desired}，就绪 {$ready}，尝试补齐"
8260                );
8261            }
8262            $this->reconcileRoleSlotGaps($role);
8263        }
8264    }

8266    private function countRoleSlotsReadyHealthy(string $role): int
8267    {
8268        $n = 0;
8269        $desired = (int) ($this->desiredState[$role] ?? 0);
8270        for ($slot = 1; $slot <= $desired; $slot++) {
8271            $inst = $this->registry->getInstance($role, $slot);
8272            if ($inst === null) {
8273                continue;
8274            }
8275            if ($inst->state !== ServiceInstance::STATE_READY) {
8276                continue;
8277            }
8278            if ($this->isExternallyManagedSharedInstance($inst)) {
8279                if ($this->isExternallyManagedSharedInstanceAlive($inst)) {
8280                    $n++;
8281                }
8282                continue;
8283            }
8284            if ($inst->ipcClientId === null
8285                || ($this->controlServer !== null && !$this->controlServer->clientExists($inst->ipcClientId))) {
8286                continue;
8287            }
8288            $n++;
8289        }
8290
8291        return $n;
8292    }
8293
8294    private function countRoleSlotsProcessAlive(string $role): int
8295    {
8296        $n = 0;
8297        $desired = (int) ($this->desiredState[$role] ?? 0);
8298        for ($slot = 1; $slot <= $desired; $slot++) {
8299            $inst = $this->registry->getInstance($role, $slot);
8300            if ($inst === null) {
8301                continue;
8302            }
8303            if ($inst->pid <= 0) {
8304                continue;
8305            }
8306            if (!$this->isProcessRunning($inst->pid)) {
8307                continue;
8308            }
8309            $n++;
8310        }
8311
8312        return $n;
8313    }

8315    /**
8316     * 按 desiredState 补齐指定角色缺失/失效槽位（与 reconcileDesiredState 单角色逻辑一致）
8317     */
8318    private function reconcileRoleSlotGaps(string $role): void
8319    {
8320        if ($this->context === null || !$this->running || $this->isStopFlowActive()) {
8321            return;
8322        }
8323        if ($this->childServicesBootstrapInProgress && $role === ControlMessage::ROLE_WORKER) {
8324            return;
8325        }
8326        if ($role === 'maintenance' && !$this->maintenanceMode) {
8327            return;
8328        }
8329        $desired = (int) ($this->desiredState[$role] ?? 0);
8330        if ($desired <= 0) {
8331            return;
8332        }
8333        $provider = $this->registry->getProvider($role);
8334        if ($provider === null || !$provider->isEnabled($this->context)) {
8335            return;
8336        }
8337
8338        for ($slot = 1; $slot <= $desired; $slot++) {
8339            $queueKey = "{$role}:{$slot}";
8340            if (isset($this->resurrectQueue[$queueKey])) {
8341                continue;
8342            }
8343            $instance = $this->registry->getInstance($role, $slot);
8344            if ($instance === null
8345                || \in_array($instance->state, [ServiceInstance::STATE_STOPPED, ServiceInstance::STATE_FAILED], true)) {
8346                WlsLogger::warning_("[Master自检] 补齐实例 {$role}#{$slot}");
8347                $this->registry->removeInstance($role, $slot);
8348                $this->startInstance($provider, $slot, $this->context);
8349                continue;
8350            }
8351            if ($instance->epoch !== $this->context->epoch) {
8352                WlsLogger::warning_("[Master自检] 回收旧代际 {$role}#{$slot} 并重启");
8353                $this->stopInstanceWithProtocol($instance);
8354                $this->registry->removeInstance($role, $slot);
8355                $this->startInstance($provider, $slot, $this->context);
8356                continue;
8357            }
8358            // READY 但 IPC 已断或进程已死：占槽无效，回收并重启（如 Dispatcher 僵死）
8359            if ($instance->state === ServiceInstance::STATE_READY) {
8360                if ($this->isExternallyManagedSharedInstance($instance)) {
8361                    if (!$this->isExternallyManagedSharedInstanceAlive($instance)) {
8362                        WlsLogger::warning_(
8363                            '[Master自检] 外部共享 sidecar ' . $role . '#' . (string) $slot . ' 已不可用，切换为本实例接管'
8364                        );
8365                        $this->registry->removeInstance($role, $slot);
8366                        $this->startInstance($provider, $slot, $this->context);
8367                    }
8368                    continue;
8369                }
8370                $ipcBad = $instance->ipcClientId === null
8371                    || ($this->controlServer !== null && !$this->controlServer->clientExists($instance->ipcClientId));
8372                $pidBad = $instance->pid > 0 && !$this->isProcessRunning($instance->pid);
8373                if ($ipcBad || $pidBad) {
8374                    WlsLogger::warning_(
8375                        '[Master自检] ' . $role . '#' . (string) $slot . ' 标记 READY 但失效 ipc='
8376                        . ($ipcBad ? '断' : '通') . ' pid=' . ($pidBad ? '死' : '活') . '，回收重启'
8377                    );
8378                    $this->stopInstanceWithProtocol($instance);
8379                    $this->registry->removeInstance($role, $slot);
8380                    $this->startInstance($provider, $slot, $this->context);
8381                }
8382            }
8383        }
8384    }

8402    /**
8403     * @return int[]
8404     */
8405    private function collectReadyWorkerPortsSorted(): array
8406    {
8407        $workerPorts = [];
8408        foreach ($this->registry->getInstancesByRole(ControlMessage::ROLE_WORKER) as $worker) {
8409            if ($worker->state === ServiceInstance::STATE_READY
8410                && $worker->port !== null
8411                && $worker->port > 0) {
8412                $workerPorts[] = (int) $worker->port;
8413            }
8414        }

8420    private function formatMaintenanceOperationContext(): string
8421    {
8422        $workerPorts = $this->collectReadyWorkerPortsSorted();
8423        $maintenancePorts = $this->collectReadyMaintenancePortsSorted();
8424        $dispatchers = $this->registry->getInstancesByRole(ControlMessage::ROLE_DISPATCHER);
8425        $dispatcherReady = 0;
8426        foreach ($dispatchers as $dispatcher) {
8427            if ($dispatcher->state === ServiceInstance::STATE_READY && $dispatcher->ipcClientId !== null) {
8428                $dispatcherReady++;
8429            }
8430        }
8431
8432        $expectedAck = \is_array($this->pendingMaintenanceModeAck['expected'] ?? null)
8433            ? \count($this->pendingMaintenanceModeAck['expected'])
8434            : 0;
8435        $acked = \is_array($this->pendingMaintenanceModeAck['acked'] ?? null)
8436            ? \count($this->pendingMaintenanceModeAck['acked'])
8437            : 0;
8438
8439        return 'maintenance_mode=' . ($this->maintenanceMode ? 'true' : 'false')
8440            . ', sticky=' . ($this->maintenanceSticky ? 'true' : 'false')
8441            . ', ready_workers=' . ($workerPorts !== [] ? \implode(',', $workerPorts) : '(none)')
8442            . ', ready_maintenance=' . ($maintenancePorts !== [] ? \implode(',', $maintenancePorts) : '(none)')
8443            . ', dispatchers=' . $dispatcherReady . '/' . \count($dispatchers)
8444            . ", pending_ack={$acked}/{$expectedAck}";
8445    }

8465    private function logMaintenanceOperation(
8466        string $message,
8467        string $level = 'INFO',

8899                    return [
8900                        'success' => false,
8901                        'message' => 'Failed to enable maintenance mode: ' . $enableResult['message'],
8902                    ];
8903                }
8904                $this->controlServer?->poll(0, 600000);
8905            }
8906        } elseif ($this->maintenanceMode && !$this->maintenanceSticky) {
8907            $this->disableMaintenanceMode();
8908            $this->controlServer?->poll(0, 400000);
8909        }
8910
8911        $this->rollingRestartInProgress = true;
8912        $this->rollingRestartClientId = $clientId;
8913        $this->rollingRestartProgress = 0;
8914        $this->rollingRestartTotal = $workerCount;
8915
8916        $this->sendRollingRestartProgress("Starting rolling restart of {$workerCount} workers");
8917
8918        $this->performRollingRestart();
8919
8920        return [

8923        ];

8926    /**
8927     * 执行滚动重启的核心逻辑
8928     */
8929    private function performRollingRestart(): void
8930    {
8931        if ($this->context === null) {
8932            $this->finishRollingRestart(false, 'Context lost');
8933            return;
8934        }
8935
8936        $epochSnap = $this->ipcImperialEpoch;
8937        if ($this->maintenanceMode) {
8938            $this->performRollingRestartWithMaintenanceWorker($epochSnap);
8939
8940            return;
8941        }
8942
8943        $this->performRollingRestartMultiWorkerWithDispatcher($epochSnap);
8944    }

8946    /**
8947     * 单 Worker：维护模式接管流量后直接重启。
8948     */
8949    private function performRollingRestartWithMaintenanceWorker(int $epochSnap): void
8950    {
8951        $startTime = \microtime(true);
8952        $workerProvider = $this->registry->getProvider('worker');
8953        if ($workerProvider === null) {
8954            $this->finishRollingRestart(false, 'Worker provider not found');
8955            return;
8956        }
8957
8958        $workers = $this->registry->getInstancesByRole('worker');
8959        $total = \count($workers);
8960        $restarted = 0;
8961
8962        foreach ($workers as $worker) {
8963            if ($this->ipcImperialEpoch !== $epochSnap || !$this->rollingRestartInProgress) {
8964                return;
8965            }
8966
8967            $instanceId = $worker->instanceId;
8968            WlsLogger::info_("[Orchestrator] 滚动重启 Worker #{$instanceId}（维护模式）");
8969            $this->sendRollingRestartProgress("Restarting worker #{$instanceId} ({$restarted}/{$total})");
8970
8971            if ($worker->ipcClientId !== null) {
8972                $this->controlServer?->sendTo($worker->ipcClientId, ControlMessage::shutdown());
8973            }
8974
8975            $startWait = \microtime(true);
8976            $maxWait = 10.0;
8977            while ((\microtime(true) - $startWait) < $maxWait) {
8978                if ($this->ipcImperialEpoch !== $epochSnap) {
8979                    return;
8980                }
8981                $this->controlServer?->poll(0, 200000);
8982                $currentWorker = $this->registry->getInstance('worker', $instanceId);
8983                if ($currentWorker === null || $currentWorker->ipcClientId === null) {
8984                    break;
8985                }
8986            }
8987
8988            if ($this->ipcImperialEpoch !== $epochSnap) {
8989                return;
8990            }
8991
8992            $this->registry->removeInstance('worker', $instanceId);
8993            $newInstance = $this->startInstance($workerProvider, $instanceId, $this->context);
8994            if ($newInstance === null) {
8995                $this->finishRollingRestart(false, "Failed to restart worker #{$instanceId}");
8996                return;
8997            }
8998
8999            if (!$this->waitWorkerReadyWithEpoch($instanceId, $this->startupTimeout, $epochSnap)) {
9000                if ($this->ipcImperialEpoch !== $epochSnap) {
9001                    return;
9002                }
9003                $this->finishRollingRestart(false, "Worker #{$instanceId} not ready within {$this->startupTimeout}s");
9004                return;
9005            }
9006
9007            $restarted++;
9008            $this->rollingRestartProgress = $restarted;
9009        }
9010
9011        $elapsedMs = (\microtime(true) - $startTime) * 1000;
9012        $this->finishRollingRestart(true, "Successfully restarted {$restarted} workers", $elapsedMs);
9013    }
9014
9015    /**
9016     * 多 Worker：按批（Worker≥阈值时智能分三批）摘除→排水→重启→批内全部 READY 后再加入 Dispatcher，未重启的 Worker 继续分担流量。
9017     */
9018    private function performRollingRestartMultiWorkerWithDispatcher(int $epochSnap): void
9019    {
9020        $startTime = \microtime(true);
9021        if ($this->registry->getProvider('worker') === null) {
9022            $this->finishRollingRestart(false, 'Worker provider not found');
9023            return;
9024        }
9025
9026        $slotIds = [];
9027        foreach ($this->registry->getInstancesByRole('worker') as $w) {
9028            $slotIds[$w->instanceId] = true;
9029        }
9030        $orderedIds = \array_keys($slotIds);
9031        \sort($orderedIds, SORT_NUMERIC);
9032        $total = \count($orderedIds);
9033        $batches = $this->getWorkerRestartBatches($orderedIds);
9034        $batchTotal = \count($batches);
9035        WlsLogger::info_(
9036            "[Orchestrator] 多 Worker 滚动重启共 {$batchTotal} 批，总 {$total} 槽位（三批阈值 wls.orchestrator.worker_three_batch_min_count）"
9037        );
9038
9039        $restarted = 0;
9040        $batchIdx = 0;
9041        foreach ($batches as $batch) {
9042            $batchIdx++;
9043            if ($this->ipcImperialEpoch !== $epochSnap || !$this->rollingRestartInProgress) {
9044                WlsLogger::warning_('[Orchestrator] 多 Worker 滚动重启中止');
9045
9046                return;
9047            }
9048            $this->sendRollingRestartProgress(
9049                "Batch {$batchIdx}/{$batchTotal}: restart workers [" . \implode(',', $batch) . "] ({$restarted}/{$total} done)"
9050            );
9051            $result = $this->restartWorkerBatchDispatcherAware(
9052                $batch,
9053                $epochSnap,
9054                'rolling',
9055                $restarted,
9056                $total,
9057                $batchIdx,
9058                $batchTotal
9059            );
9060            if ($result === 'aborted') {
9061                return;
9062            }
9063            if ($result === 'failed') {
9064                return;
9065            }
9066            $restarted += \count($batch);
9067            $this->rollingRestartProgress = $restarted;
9068        }
9069
9070        $elapsedMs = (\microtime(true) - $startTime) * 1000;
9071        $this->finishRollingRestart(
9072            true,
9073            "Successfully restarted {$restarted} workers ({$batchTotal} batch(es), dispatcher-aware)",
9074            $elapsedMs
9075        );
9076    }

9078    private function waitWorkerReadyWithEpoch(int $instanceId, float $timeout, int $epochSnap): bool
9079    {
9080        $startWait = \microtime(true);
9081        while ((\microtime(true) - $startWait) < $timeout) {
9082            if ($this->ipcImperialEpoch !== $epochSnap) {
9083                return false;
9084            }
9085            $this->controlServer?->poll(0, 200000);
9086            $currentWorker = $this->registry->getInstance('worker', $instanceId);
9087            if ($currentWorker !== null && $currentWorker->state === Contract\ServiceInstance::STATE_READY) {
9088                return true;
9089            }
9090        }
9091
9092        return false;
9093    }

9095    /**
9096     * 完成滚动重启
9097     */
9098    private function finishRollingRestart(bool $success, string $message, float $elapsedMs = 0): void
9099    {
9100        WlsLogger::info_("[Orchestrator] 滚动重启完成: success={$success}, message={$message}, elapsed={$elapsedMs}ms");
9101
9102        // 先清理滚动标志，再禁用维护模式，避免 disableMaintenanceMode() 因“滚动中”被拒绝。
9103        $clientId = $this->rollingRestartClientId;
9104        $progress = $this->rollingRestartProgress;
9105        $total = $this->rollingRestartTotal;
9106        $this->rollingRestartInProgress = false;
9107        $this->rollingRestartClientId = null;
9108
9109        if (!$this->maintenanceSticky) {
9110            $disableResult = $this->disableMaintenanceMode();
9111            if (!($disableResult['success'] ?? false)) {
9112                WlsLogger::warning_("[Orchestrator] 滚动重启后禁用维护模式失败: " . ($disableResult['message'] ?? 'unknown'));
9113            }
9114        }
9115
9116        if ($success) {
9117            if ($this->maintenanceSticky) {
9118                $this->pushMaintenanceWorkerPoolToDispatchersFromRegistry();
9119            } else {
9120                $this->syncDispatcherFullWorkerPoolFromRegistry();
9121            }
9122        }
9123
9124        if ($clientId !== null) {
9125            $msgType = $success ? ControlMessage::TYPE_RELOAD_COMPLETED : ControlMessage::TYPE_RELOAD_FAILED;
9126            $this->controlServer?->sendTo($clientId, ControlMessage::encode([
9127                'type' => $msgType,
9128                'success' => $success,
9129                'message' => $message,
9130                'progress' => $progress,
9131                'total' => $total,
9132                'elapsed_ms' => $elapsedMs,
9133                'worker_count' => $total,
9134            ]));
9135        }
9136
9137        $this->rollingRestartProgress = 0;
9138        $this->rollingRestartTotal = 0;
9139
9140        if ($this->context !== null) {
9141            $this->persistServicesInfo($this->context);
9142        }
9143    }

9708                ServiceInstance::STATE_STOPPED,

9711                $this->registry->updateInstance($instance);
9712            }
9713            if ($this->context !== null) {
9714                $this->persistServicesInfo($this->context);
9715            }
9716            WlsLogger::info_(

9745        }

9811    /**

9878    /**
9879     * 委托给 Processer 检查进程存活
9880     */
9881    private function isProcessRunning(int $pid): bool
9882    {
9883        if ($pid <= 0) {
9884            return false;
9885        }
9886        $now = \microtime(true);
9887        $cached = $this->processRunningCache[$pid] ?? null;
9888        if ($cached !== null && ($now - (float) $cached['checkedAt']) <= $this->processRunningCacheTtlSec) {
9889            return (bool) $cached['running'];
9890        }
9891        $running = Processer::isRunningByPid($pid);
9892        $this->processRunningCache[$pid] = [
9893            'running' => $running,
9894            'checkedAt' => $now,
9895        ];
9896        if (\count($this->processRunningCache) > 512) {
9897            $this->processRunningCache = [];
9898        }
9899        return $running;
9900    }
